Is your organization striving to be an environmental leader?

TD Bank Group is doing so by building sustainability into its core business strategies, and setting an ambitious GHG reduction target – pledging to reduce per capita CO2e emissions from 3.58 tonnes/person in their 2008 baseline year to 2.58 tonnes/person by 2015. At this educational forum Karen Clarke-Whistler, Chief Environmental Officer of TD Bank Group, will be sharing further details of how TD has approached claiming a leadership position in business sustainability, and advice on how your organization can learn from what they have done to date.

 

Karen Clark-Whistler, Chief Environmental Officer, TD Bank Group

Karen Clarke-Whistler is currently the Chief Environment Officer of TD Bank Group (TD), a position she has held since she joined the bank in 2008. In this role, Karen is responsible for developing and leading TD’s environment strategy, which has enabled the bank to differentiate itself by embedding an environmental perspective throughout its business operations and has been instrumental in making it an environmental leader – TD was the first North American-based bank to be carbon neutral.


An environmental scientist, Karen is widely recognized as a thought leader in environmental business matters. Prior to joining TD, she spent more than 15 years working as an environmental consultant to a diverse base of clients in North and South America, Europe and Africa.


In recognizing that the environment is a fundamental driver of economic success, Karen is able to provide a unique perspective to the business world – one that is helping to redefine how business approaches the environment.


Recognized as one of the 2011 Clean50 (50 individuals honoured for their outstanding contribution to clean capitalism), Karen holds a master’s degree in land resource science from the University of Guelph and a bachelor’s degree in ecology from the University of Toronto.


Karen currently lives in Toronto.

description:
Your Unique Brand of Value – Mini Workshop on Aligning Your Business Brand with the Truth of Who You Are

 

o   Do you ever freeze up when someone asks you what you do, wondering if you’re going to say the right thing?

o   Do you get confused about the difference between having a business and having a brand?

o   Is being unclear in your marketing, keeping clients from saying “yes?”

Wouldn’t it be great if you could get your brand messaging down to a few key words that would always remind you of exactly who you are and what you are about?  Even better… make it simple and easy to communicate to your prospects so that they get who you are, and the RIGHT people want to buy?

o   No more spending time with clients that don’t see your unique value.

o   No more wondering what to title your workshop or speech, or what to put on the sign at your sponsor booth!

o   Most importantly, feel the peace and confidence that comes from being clear about what you are about and who you serve.

These things make a huge difference in being the type of entrepreneur who loves their work and brings 100% of themselves to the table.

Join us 7:00-9:00PM Friday June 14th, at the Hilton Minneapolis/Bloomington located at 3900 American West Blvd. in the Jefferson Room, for this unique branding experience.

  • See behind the scenes as 10 extraordinary entrepreneurs share in brief snapshot (think 10 words or less) who they are and what they are about in their business
  •  Vote with MY dollars for which brands you think work the best.  (Fun money involved)
  •  Debrief the process of getting clear on your Unique Point of View side by side with my clients who have done the work.
  • Participate in your personal exercise to hone in on your unique brand of value!

This workshop is just $15 to attend.  We’d make it free but you are not likely to show up.  And we have limited seating (15 participants) so we need to know you’ll be there!  There’s nothing that warms my heart more than an entrepreneur who is clear in what they are about.  You’ll have a chance to mingle and network, hear me teach on branding and the difference between your brand message and a marketing campaign, and participate in a small group mastermind session.

This type of experience would typically cost hundreds of dollars, and it is a 5-figure investment to work with me privately, but this unique event is an experiment – new city, new content – so you can come for just $15!

Beer, wine, and light snacks will be provided.  Think of it as a business branding party!  See you there!


 Darla LeDoux, Profit Acceleration Coach and owner at AlignandProfit.com http://AlignandProfit.com spent much of her life in corporate, doing all the things she was “supposed” do to be successful. She made sure to always “look smart,” and have “right answers” as a consumer researcher and product development engineer. When she began to notice her right answers were actually wrong for her, she was terrified. She resisted her calling as entrepreneur, speaker, and coach for 10+ years (Darla calls this the Great Entrepreneurial Flip-Flop) then finally made a decision to step into her Truth and follow her heart.


Darla guides frustrated business owners into alignment with their TRUE business goals and supports them to design their programs, packages, pricing, and marketing, and to align with ideal clients, and profit, with ease.

The San Francisco Legal Forum 

Please join us for our Wednesday, June 19th lunch program: 

Employment Law Update & Recent Supreme Court Decisions

Join us for a lively discussion of the constantly changing world of employment law.  Our speakers this month include two veteran, well-respected attorneys who will battle it out from both the plaintiff’s and defendant’s viewpoints.  Topics include new employment laws for 2013 and a discussion of the highly anticipated U.S. Supreme Court employment cases decisions this year.

 

SPEAKERS: 

Matthew Righetti, Esq. - Plaintiffs Employment Attorney 

www.righettilaw.com

Mr. Righetti has been specializing in representing claimants in civil trials for over twenty-five years with a particular emphasis on class action litigation. He routinely litigates cases against the nation's largest corporations and is nationally recognized and respected by his peers as a skillful advocate on behalf of victims.  In addition to his trial experience, Mr. Righetti has also successfully litigated numerous appeals in the nation's highest state and federal courts.  Several examples include, Sav-On Drugstores, Inc. v. Superior Court, (2004) 34 Cal.4th 319) [California Supreme Court decision reversed the court of appeal and reinstated the trial court's class certification order in a wage and hour class action]; Gentry v, Superior Court (2007) 42 Cal.4th 443 [California Supreme Court reversed both the trial court and court of appeal decisions thereby invalidating a ban on class actions contained in an employment agreement]; Rutti v. Lojack Corp., Inc. (2010) 596 F.3d 1046 [granting a petition for rehearing, ninth district court's summary judgment order finding work compensable under both state and federal law]; Winfrey v. Chief Auto Parts, Inc., First District Court of Appeal [reversing trial court's order denying certification].  Mr. Righetti has tried dozens of complex cases in his career and has recovered hundreds of millions of dollars for his clients on both class action and individual claims ranging from employment, labor, wage and hour, product liability, personal injury, wrongful death, and privacy rights.

Join YPT Boston on a technical tour with MassDOT as your guide! Learn about some of Boston's amazing transportation infrastructure on Thursday, July 19th beginning at 9:00 AM.   •     Intake/exhaust systems and power systems for the Central Artery/Tunnels
  •     Zakim Bridge
  •     MassDOT Highway Operations Center (HOC)


The tour will begin at the State Transportation Building on Stuart Street between Tremont and Charles Streets, and will start off with a presentation about the complex construction methods used during the Central Artery/Tunnel Project (the Big Dig). MassDOT officials will also discuss their current maintenance and operations procedures of the artery/tunnels. After seeing some of the tunnel systems, the tour will travel to the Zakim Bridge to see the bridge deck, some structural components of the bridge, and the bridge underside. Nobel Laureate Professor Peter Doherty and Eureka Prize Winner Professor Ian Frazer in conversation. Moderated by Reema Rattan Health Editor for theconversation.edu.au.

Health Literacy: Public Health & Evidence-based Medicine

We frequently hear about general literacy levels in the community, and even about science and maths literacy, but rarely about the wider public understanding of evidence-based health matters. The exception to this has been the vaccination vs antivaccination arguments playing itself out in online threads all over the internet; in newspapers and current affairs programmes; and even in celebrity gossip columns with the likes of Jim Carey and Bill Maher making their ideas heard. At Giants of Medicine we'll hear on these matters and more from two of the world's most important contributors to medical science, Nobel Laureate Professor Peter Doherty and Eureka Prize Winner Professor Ian Frazer. Discussion to be moderated by Reema Rattan Health Editor for The Conversation followed by 20 mins for Q&A.

Embiggen Books

description:
We all love to escape with a book on holiday – and many of us harbour dreams of having our name on the cover. Meet three authors who know how it's done

  

Join three of our favourite novelists – who will feature in many a Red beach bag this summer – in conversation with Red’s literary editor Viv Groskop (herself a published author), and learn how to plot, write and get your story published.

 

Meet the authors

 

Tasmina Perry

When Tasmina struggled to find a beach read at the airport, she decided to write her own. As you do. Luckily, that first book, Daddy’s Girls, written while on honeymoon, went straight into the Sunday Times bestseller list. A former magazine journalist, Tasmina is also a qualified lawyer, and had already set up her own travel magazine, Jaunt, when she embarked on her novel-writing career – in other words, career change is her specialty. With seven chunky beach read best-sellers on her CV, she's currently working on her ninth book, The Proposal, and her latest novel, Deep Blue Sea, is published July 18th (Headline Review).

 

Lisa Jewell

She's a bestselling author with over a million book sales to her name, but Lisa wrote her first novel for a bet. After being made redundant from her job as a receptionist and PA, in 1996, she accepted a friend’s challenge and began writing Ralph’s Party while temping in the Royal Festival Hall’s HR department. The bet paid off. Ralph's Party was snapped up by Penguin, and went on to become the UK’s bestselling debut novel of 1999. Lisa's success continued with bestsellers such as Thirtynothing and One-hit Wonder, and her eleventh novel, The House We Grew Up In, is published on July 18th (Century).

 

Flic Everett

Agony aunt, columnist, online travel entrepreneur and now novelist – Flic’s CV is an eclectic one. At just 25, she was the Manchester Evening News' chief columnist. Since then, she’s forged a stellar career in journalism, with commissions for the Guardian, Red and a host of other magazines. She's also co-founder of website Road, Rail & Sea (roadrailandsea.co.uk). Her novel-writing career began at 39 when, after months of back-and-forth with an agent, she decided to go the self-publishing route. Flic was converted. She self-published The Only Friends You Need in 2012, and is currently working on her second novel.

description:
Designing Repeat Patterns for Homewares: Part One

From Florence Broadhurst to Merimekko

Jean Kropper in partnership with Jenny O’Brien of

In The Picture, Hornsby (framing shop)

 

Ever wanted to design your own patterns? Decorate your own cushion covers, placemats, or a lampshade?

Come learn the technical skills to design patterns, learn what a ‘repeat’ is and the basic elements that make a pattern work.  We will look at sample patterns, then sketch your own. I’ll show you how to cut your pattern into a stamp and how to print with them.  This will give you an understanding of colour, spacing and orientation of elements within a pattern. You can practice printing with stamps I have created and then work with your own on a length of muslin. There are a huge variety of sophisticated creative choices available within this process.

Wear old clothes or an apron. It is important that you can relax and enjoy getting your hands dirty without worrying about getting a mark on good clothes. Do not bring precious fabrics. This is a time to learn new skills with the freedom to make mistakes. Artists, graphic designers, and beginners are all welcome. You will leave with new skills and many ideas to continue on your own. 

We will cover:

  • Learn the basic elements that make a pattern work
  • Understand what “a repeat” is and how they interlock
  • Create a background texture
  • Understand the spacing and orientation of images within a pattern
  • Design three to four related graphic images to be used to build a pattern
  • Transfer the images to dense foam and cut it to make unique stamps
  • Learn to ink and print with your own stamps on fabric or paper.

Materials, handouts and most importantly, morning tea provided. Free parking.
name: Designing Repeat Patterns for Homewares: Part One

description:
Missed it?

This game is over!  However, there are more games to come:

  • Thursday 2013
  • Wednesday 2013



In Brief

1. Meet Some People

2. Play a Board Game

3. Talk About It

Places are limited, so register above to make sure you get to play!


In Detail

Perspectivity is a board game, run by a facilitator, that allows you to manage a country's economic growth through an era of rapid change.

In less than an hour you'll have designed and implemented a game plan with five other countries. You'll have negotiated economic and environmental crises and guessed what your neighbouring countries are up to. In your effort to maximise revenues will you be surprised, frustrated or, ultimately, win?

What are the dynamics that influence the game? Where does trust come from? Who is playing by the rules? What strategies seem to work?

Come along to play at being politician or CEO, to learn new skills, meet new people and most of all, to have fun!

  

  

 

About the Game

Six teams of two take charge of growing their economies through industrial development to try to maximise their score in a complex world. However, as each pursue their individual aims, they are affected by the behaviour of the other players.

After the game, spend time unpacking the themes, the lessons and the behaviours that you saw and experienced. Examine the dynamics of the game and discuss how they relate to your work and community.

This video gives a flavour of what it's like:


The whole game session and debrief lasts around 2.5 hours. There will be two games running simultaneously.

 

Who Else has Played?

World Bank, Cambridge University, London School of Economics, PwC, Manchester Business School, DSM Global Products, RSA and many more have caught the bug.


  

  

Photos from an open session in London.


“WOW what a buzz from the session, colleagues are talking about it and thinking about how they approach work, life, their responsibility – itʼs been a real benefit to us who have played the game - thank you both for bringing so much to our session.”
Alison Howard, Sustainability Manager, Monmouthshire County Council


Register Now!

You are invited to come along to experience the game and pit your strategies against the other players at an open game session in Exeter.

Only the first 24 people registered with will get to play, so reserve a place by signing up for a ticket above.

They have agreed to host the Perspectivity session on a pay-what-you-like basis, with half of the proceeds going towards improving the facilities.

Synopsis:

“Modern slavery.” It sounds like a paradox. Hasn’t humanity progressed? Didn’t we leave slavery dead on the battlefields of the American Civil War? Didn’t social reformers like Lincoln and Wilberforce legislate against such cruelty over a hundred years ago? So we had thought. But, with over 27 million enslaved people in the world, human trafficking is once again the battlefront of the century.

Regardless of nationality, victims are systematically stripped of their identity, battered into gruesome submission, and made to perform humiliating sexual acts on up to 40 strangers every night. Most are held in dingy apartments and brothels, forced to take heavy doses of illegal drugs, and monitored very closely. Victims are often thrown into such ghastly oppression at 13 years old. Some are abducted outright, while others are lured out of poverty, romantically seduced, or sold by their families.

Nefarious, Merchant of Souls, is a hard-hitting documentary that exposes the disturbing trends in modern sex slavery. From the very first scene, Nefarious ushers you into the nightmare of sex slavery that hundreds of thousands experience daily. You’ll see where slaves are sold (often in developed, affluent countries), where they work, and where they are confined. You’ll hear first-hand interviews with real victims and traffickers, along with expert analysis from international humanitarian leaders.

From initial recruitment to victim liberation—and everything in between—the previously veiled underworld of sex slavery is uncovered in the groundbreaking, tell-all Nefarious, Merchant of Souls.

Join us for an evening of fine art and fine wine as Cosimo Pizzulli, famed architect and winemaker, leads guests in a tasting of Pizzulli Family Wines.


"As a young child, I watched my grandfather make wine in his basement in New York, and I always had a fascination for what he was doing. When I had the opportunity to buy this large property in the Palisades 11 years ago, I decided to build a vineyard on the whole hillside. In a sense, it was a continuation of what my grandfather did."

He met winemakers in Malibu who taught him harvesting, pruning, crushing, de-stemming and processing. After making wine successfully on his 1.5-acre property on Marquette Street (above Las Pulgas Canyon), he decided to sell his wines in a commercial venue.

In 2007, he began buying grapes from a Los Alamos vineyard in Santa Barbara County and created the Pizzulli Family Winery, located in Camarillo. Pizzulli's wines are now served at Los Angeles-based restaurants and wine shops and will be featured at the Maison Giraud. He makes San giovese, Nebbiolo, Barbera, Dolcetto and Nebbiolo Rose. His 2008 Dol cetto received the 2010 Double Gold Medal / Best of Class at the California State Fair.

This event is hosted at The Loft at Liz's, a fine art gallery located in LA's historic Miracle Mile Arts District near LACMA.  Our current exhibit, entitled "OENOPHILIA" features works from 12 artists on the subject of wine. 


Our annual nature show takes a turn, winding its way through country vineyards,
examining the rich cultural history of viticulture.  Earliest records have shown the discovery of fermentation as early as 7000 BC and its influence on the world of art is undeniable.  Wine has been celebrated and stored artistically for centuries for spiritual rituals, religious ceremonies, medicinal purposes and social occasions.  Our featured artists explore these rich histories – creating works ‘under the influence’ in a manner of speaking.  Join us in celebration as The Loft at Liz’s welcomes you to raise a glass for Oenophilia.

description:
From Clayton

Join us for the most unique and complete Boldt Castle Tour! The tour begins at the new pavilion in Clayton that is a replica of the train station that was where all the rich and famous started their vacation in the area. Our experienced local guides provide a live narrative of the sites on both the American and Canadian sides of the St Lawrence River. This international tour will include several miles of the Canadian shoreline encompassing the magnificent summer homes, Whirlpool Channel, Tom Thumb Island, the Statue of Saint Lawrence, the Canadian span of the 1000 Island Bridge system along with the smallest International Bridge.

We will than stop at Heart Island to enjoy a self guided tour of Boldt Castle. Departing Boldt Castle you will cruise Millionaires Row passing summer homes of the rich and famous. As we cruise the American Channel you will enjoy the rich history, folk lore and the large ships as they carry cargo to and from the Ocean. After passing under the American Span of the 1000 Bridge System Rock Island Light house will appear as a historical land make reminding us of days gone by.

Details:

Schedule:

May 25th to June 9th: Saturdays and Sundays 1:30pm

June 10th to June 21st: 1:30pm daily

June 22nd to September 3rd: 10:00am and 1:30pm daily
September 4th to September 15th: 1:30pm daily

Duration: 3 hours

Rates: Adults $18.00 / Children (4 to 12 years) $12.00

*Cost of boat ticket does not include admission into the castle.

NO PASSPORT REQUIRED.

description:
This workshop will give you the skills to create a variety of print ready materials, including flyers and print spreads. In this session you will learn to use many tools in InDesign to create design elements and feature text.

By the end of the session you’ll know how to link and relink images and text, wrap text, type on a path and number pages. You’ll also be across styles and a range of handy shortcuts.

To participate in this workshop you must have a basic understanding of InDesign tools and processes including how to set up documents and place text and images. If these skills aren’t in your toolkit, try out the intro session first or book in for a one-on-one session prior to this workshop.

Once you have completed this workshop you will be prepared to take on the Advanced InDesign workshop.

Got questions? Here are a few that come up regularly:

I can't book tickets?
There are a couple of reasons why you might not be able to book a place. Firstly, tickets sales may not have opened. If this is the case, under "End" in the registration information it will list "Not started". You can find details of when bookings open on our website.

If the session has booked out under "Quantity" in the registration information it will list "Sold Out". You may be able to put your name on the waitlist.

How do I put my name on the waitlist?
If places are available on the waitlist, the ‘Add my name to waitlist’ option will appear in the bottom right corner of the registration information box. Full details on how we use the waitlist can be found on our website.

What if I can no longer attend a workshop?
Please so show respect for those on the waitlist and let us know as soon as possible if you are unable to make it so we can offer your place to someone else.

If you have not arrived in time for the commencement of a free, intro workshop your place may be given to someone who is onsite and ready to attend. You can email us or give us a call on 07 3842 9400 if you are going to be late. Places in paid workshops will not be reallocated.

Is there a minimum age for participants?
This session is designed for participants aged 15 and up.

Do I need any prior experience to participate?
All our introductory level workshops assume no prior knowledge. They are perfect for beginners. In all our other workshops no prior experience is required unless specifically stated.

Do I need to bring anything to this workshop?
Unless specifically stated in the workshop description you do not need to bring anything to this workshop. Some participants do find it useful to bring a notebook or a tablet to take notes.

Still got questions? Check out our guide to booking an Edge workshop or email us with your questions.

org_desc:
The Federalist Society for Law and Public Policy Studies is a group of conservatives and libertarians interested in the current state of the legal order.  It is founded on three principles:

  1. That the state exists to preserve freedom;
  2. That the separation of governmental powers is central to our Constitution; and,
  3. That it is emphatically the province and duty of the judiciary to say what the law is, not what it should be.  

The Society seeks both to promote an awareness of these principles and to further their application through its activities.

This entails reordering priorities within the legal system to place a premium on individual liberty, traditional values, and the rule of law.  It also requires restoring the recognition of the importance of these norms among lawyers, judges, law students and professors.  In working to achieve these goals, the Society has created a conservative and libertarian intellectual network that extends to all levels of the legal community.

The St. Louis Lawyers' Chapter of the Federalist Society hosts various events for the Eastern Missouri and Southern Illinois legal community.  Among other benefits, members of the Federalist Society for Law and Public Policy Studies receive discounted tickets to all of our events.  To see other benefits of membership or to become a member, visit www.fed-soc.org.

description:
G.F. Handel: Il Trionfo del tempo e del disinganno


The year is 1707...

Handel’s Il Trionfo del tempo e del disinganno occupies a special place in the history of what has become a genre in its own right, Handelian Oratorio.  This oratorio was the first for the young twenty-one year old Handel, already famous and with a formidable self-awareness as to his music contributions.  The Bach Collegium has assembled four world class soloists to make vivid Cardinal Benedetto Pamphili's 1707 libretto. Based upon the poetry of Petrarch, the text is a poetic argument for the virtue in turning our attention from fleshly preoccupations to those of the spirit. Though both sides make vigorous poetic and musical arguments, there is a clear winner. The pleasure is in hearing the argument.
name: 1707: G.F. Handel: Il Trionfo del tempo e del disinganno (Balboa Park)

SPEAKER BIO
Elizabeth Viera Talbot is the speaker/director for Jesus101 Biblical Institute (jesus101institute.org). She travels throughout the United States and internationally as a lecturer and revival/motivational speaker. 

Since her early childhood her parents instilled in her the love of Jesus. Her dream of preaching and teaching became a reality when the Seventh-day Adventist Church invited her to become a full-time pastor after working many years in the business world. 

Elizabeth is married to Patrick Talbot, a marriage and family therapist. The couple has three adult daughters and three grandchildren.

Elizabeth’s main identity is her passion about the good news of Jesus Christ: "It’s like fire in my bones," she says, and she means it!

 

SEMINAR DESCRIPTIONS

Worn Out Women

So many ladies are too busy to really live. Join Mary Ellen Carlson, trained mental health counselor, to talk about the relationships, the thoughts, the beliefs that dull us and learn how to become a full reflection of what God really created us for. This seminar has take-home activities and advice for developing personal habits of emotional and spiritual wellness.

 

Mind Over Matter

"Mind over Matter" is a topic that has intrigued many scientists and psychologists. The question of how and why certain people are more likely to possess the ability to place their mind over their physical tendencies is at the center of this mystery. Come learn with Dr. Esther Park Hwang how your mind works and learn how to care for the most important part of your being.

 

Safeguarding Your Family

Women are the caretakers of the family in good and bad times. It’s important to prepare our families for a disaster — before the disaster happens. Come learn from disaster preparedness instructor, Zhalena Slaughter, practical ways to prepare your family to survive three or more days during a disaster.

 

Biblical Steps for Intercessory Prayer

As we face life’s challenges, circumstances, losses and even successes, it is vital we trust in God’s sovereign will for ourselves, our family and churches. Every believer is called to participate in the power and privilege of praying which is vital for spiritual revival. Intimacy with God is the first step as we desire anointing and answers for our prayers. Based upon God’s clear teachings and personal experiences, Carol J. Smith, life coach, will share creative ways for interceding for God’s glory.

 

Just for Teens: True Intimacy

Take an in depth look with Chaplain Jennifer Woody into the relationship God craves to have with us, while having victory through Christ over the lies the devil feeds us on sex, image and identity.

description:
Your Food.  Your Medicine.  Your Healthcare.  

                    Has All Been DOCTORED

 

The Monopolization Of Our Medical System


From the award winning producer who brought you On Native Soil comes a shocking new documentary on the monopolization of our medical system. 

“Your back pain will require SURGERY”

“Without these pills, you face life-long PAIN”

“Your child’s behavior requires MEDICATION”

That’s what the doctor tells you, but who tells the doctor what to say?

Influencers

A visit to the doctor can be traumatic enough. Now we learn about the “influencers” – the people you never see, but whose job it is to turn you into a compliant, pill popping, revenue generation unit. And at all costs. Doctored reveals the unseen tactics of these “influencers” in an investigation that leads to the highest levels of the American Medical Association (AMA) and reveals an alarming portrait of deception and criminality. Along the way we wonder: Is much of what we “know” about modern medicine just slick marketing from companies that profit when we’re in pain (or by putting us in pain)? Why aren’t we being told about the successes of natural therapies? Why do so many people think chiropractors are “quacks,” nutritional supplements a waste of money, and acupuncture a fringe therapy?

Medical Monopoly

Is it because the “Medical Monopoly” spends millions a year attacking, ridiculing, and trying to discredit these natural therapies? The answers are almost beyond belief, until Doctored takes us into the courtroom with five chiropractors who, having been labeled “an unscientific cult,’ fought back and won a landmark verdict. Their heroic story forms the backdrop of one of the most personally compelling documentaries ever. Because of their bravery, the medical industrial complex is no longer blocking access to safe natural alternatives, pill popping is giving way to smarter preventative care, and purveyors of sickness are being shoved aside, resulting in a healthier life for us all.

Critic's Quotes

“An involving, well-crafted, humane look at a topic that stands to affect us all.” -LA TIMES

“Indictments of a market-based health system predisposed toward prescription drugs and surgery when less invasive, less expensive methods might be, heaven forbid, more effective.” – NY TIMES

“A well-chosen array of practitioners and their vastly improved patients, whose issues include chronic pain, frozen shoulder syndrome, multiple sclerosis, Lyme disease, autism and cancer, offer enlightening testimony on behalf of chiropractic treatment.”- CHICAGO TRIBUNE

“Doctored frames the nearly century-long campaign against chiropractic care as a marketplace battle in which the stakes are dollars rather than health.”- THE VILLAGE VOICE

“A vital eye opening expose. A must see.”-NYC MOVIE GURU

 - To provide the highest standard of education to students wishing to become professional artists 

 - To give creative opportunities to the wider community 

 - To encourage debate around the practice and principles of Higher Education in Fine Art

 

Our principles are:

description:
Here it is. . .

Your first chance to see and learn about Google Glass up close and personal. . .

Join 106 Miles, Edtric, OC Hackerz, ROC, Startup OC and worklab.cc in this meetup mashup to preview the most anticipated product launch of the year. 

Even when the world of wearable devices has existed for some time now, Google Glass has made a big splash and is the wearable device that today offers the best promise of making wearables massively adopted.

 

Google Glass on the Spot will explore Google Glass in the light of the Explorers Program, from the user perspective as well as the business opportunities that Glass is opening up.

 

The first part of our session will cover a general introduction to the state of the art, user experience and current possibilities of Google Glass. It will include demonstrations straight from Glass of basic mechanics, uses and current applications (called Glassware). Also, the near future capabilities of Glass will be demonstrated by showing current Glass hacks that make the device more readily available for context augmentation, live processing and multiple other specialized uses.

 

The second half of our session will be geared towards business scenarios and potential for Glass. We’ll briefly review available emulators, tools and examples you can use to develop and test for Glass. We’ll explore the available business possibilities,  estimate future revenue models you can put into play to profit from Glass, talk adoption, competition and related technology that will serve to magnify glass. We’ll also discuss the overall market opportunity and explore how to ensure maximum traction, utility and appeal.

Glass is already opening a new wave of innovation in the level of hardware, software and business opportunities. We invite you to be a part of this new technological wave!

Our Speaker:


A passionate evangelizer about everything digital, Cecilia Abadie is a Google Glass Explorer and Pioneer spreading the word about wearable devices and the many ways they can change our world.


As founder of 33Labs, she leads a global development team that researches and develops wearable and mobile applications delivering experiences that innovate and disrupt both the personal and the enterprise realms. As a Product Manager with

Full Swing Golf, she has envisioned and created a vibrant community of Indoor Golfers around the world.


Before that she was an international software consultant and a software developer since the age of thirteen. Cecilia was born in Argentina, South America and raised in Uruguay. She immigrated to the United States of America ten years ago and is currently living in Southern California.

This workshop is aimed specifically at participants who have at least a basic knowledge of PHP programming and who want to use the elements available in the Joomla Content Management System version 3 codebase. 

You’ll learn about template modification, core output overrides, the MVC architecture of Joomla, and the basic structure of components, modules, and plugins.  This is a hands-on workshop, but not for the feint-of-heart.  You will be using a text editor to examine the most important structures in the Joomla codebase, and will be exposed to some fundamental object-oriented programming patterns and principles.

To participate in this workshop you will need to have a strong understanding of the Joomla Content Management System. If these skills aren’t in your toolkit, try out the intermediate session first or book in for a one-on-one session prior to this workshop.

 

Got questions? Here are a few that come up regularly:

I can't book tickets?
There are a couple of reasons why you might not be able to book a place. Firstly, tickets sales may not have opened. If this is the case, under "End" in the registration information it will list "Not started".

If the session has booked out under "Quantity" in the registration information it will list "Sold Out". You may be able to put your name on the waitlist.

How do I put my name on the waitlist?
If places are available on the waitlist, the ‘Add my name to waitlist’ option will appear in the bottom right corner of the registration information box.

Full details on how we use the waitlist can be found on our website.

What if I can no longer attend a workshop?
Please so show respect for those on the waitlist and let us know as soon as possible if you are unable to make it so we can offer your place to someone else.

Can I get a refund for this workshop?
If you email us with more than 7 days notice we will happily refund your place in this session. This is the minimum amount of time we require to find someone to take your spot.

Is there a minimum age for participants?
This sessions is designed for participants aged 15 and up.

Do I need any prior experience to participate?
All our introductory level workshops assume no prior knowledge. They are perfect for beginners. In all our other workshops no prior experience is required unless specifically stated.

Do I need to bring anything to this workshop?
Unless specifically stated in the workshop description you do not need to bring anything to this workshop. Some participants do find it useful to bring a notebook or a tablet to take notes.

description:
Crucial Conversations Training - Perth

Whenever you’re not getting the results you’re looking for, it’s likely that a crucial conversation is keeping you stuck. Whether it’s a problem with poor quality, slow time-to-market, declining customer satisfaction, or a strained relationship—whatever the issue—if you can’t talk honestly with nearly anybody about almost anything, you can expect poor results.

On the other hand, make Crucial Conversations skills your best practices and everything gets better.

Crucial Conversations is a two-day course that teaches skills for creating alignment and agreement by fostering open dialogue around high-stakes, emotional, or risky topics—at all levels of your organisation. By learning how to speak and be heard (and encouraging others to do the same), you’ll begin to surface the best ideas, make the highest-quality decisions, and then act on your decisions with unity and commitment.
name: Crucial Conversations Training - Perth
org_desc:
What is Crucial Conversations?

Based on more than twenty-five years of research, Crucial Conversations training transfers skills that top performers routinely use to effectively handle difficult conversations. With Crucial Conversations skills you can create more positive results across an entire organisation.

  • If you don’t talk it out in tough conversations, you will act it out.

  • Make a conversations safe enough, you can talk to almost anyone about almost anything.

  • Its not a communications program; it’s about getting better results and better relationships.

  • Tools to keep your unspoken thoughts from driving you to silence or becoming aggressive.

  • Our lives begin to end the day we become silent about things that matter” M. Luther King.



Crucial Conversations training teaches individuals and teams how to willingly and effectively surface and discuss ideas in a way that leads to virtually everyone buying into the decisions—creating broad alignment, maximising synergy, and ensuring commitment to the best ideas. When taught, these skills inevitably result in rapid, sustainable, positive changes in getting results.

Organizado por las asociaciones de Antiguos Alumnos de Rotterdam School of Management y de UCLA Anderson España



Estimados compañeros del Ryder Club:

El próximo jueves 27 de junio en Madrid, tendrá lugar el evento de e-Emprendedores con dos reconocidos empresarios e inversores de éxito en el mundo del e-commerce en nuestro país.

François Derbaix (fundador de toprural.com, co-fundador entre otros de rentalia.com y business angel) y Fernando Encinar (co-fundador entre otros de idealista.com, 11870.com y business angel) nos aportarán su visión sobre las oportunidades que la transformación digital está generando a la hora de poner en marcha start-ups disruptivas y escalables. Os incluimos un resumen de sus biografías al final de este mensaje.

El evento, de dos horas de duración, comenzará puntualmente a las 19:30hs en el salón Paraninfo de la sede del International Institute, Calle Miguel Ángel 8, Madrid, seguido de un cocktail con picoteo en el jardín privado de la institución.

 

RESERVAS

Para reservar tu plaza, por favor has la transferencia a través de este link mediante tarjeta de crédito/débito, indicando claramente el nombre de los asistentes. El coste del evento es €19,83.

RSVP antes del 24 de junio. El aforo es limitado y las plazas se asignarán por estricto orden de reserva. Se ruega estricta puntualidad a todos los asistentes.

Estamos seguros de que será un debate muy interesante, ¡os esperamos!

 


Bios


 

      FRANÇOIS DERBAIX 

   François Derbaix es Ingeniero de Gestión (UCL, Bélgica, 1997). Fue consultor en BCG desde 1997 a 1999. Luego se mudó a Madrid y fundó Toprural (2000), del que fue CEO hasta su venta a HomeAway en 2012. También ha sido co-fundador de Rentalia (2003), vendido a idealista.com en 2012. En la actualidad es co-fundador de Soysuper.com, un agregador de supermercados, e inversor y asesor en más de 20 negocios de Internet en España, entre los cuales 11870.com, Kantox, Comunitae, Tiendeo, Percentil. Más información en su blog y en twitter @fderbaix.

 

     FERNANDO ENCINAR

  Fernando Encinar es cofundador de idealista.com, el portal inmobiliario líder en España - y su versión italiana, idealista.it- y de 11870.com, la página web de recomendaciones de sitios y servicios más consultada en España. También participa como pequeño inversor en acierto.com, mumumio.com y tiendeo.com.

Antes de iniciar su trayectoria como e-Emprendedor, Fernando trabajó en consultoría de PR y comunicación corporativa en Edelman España y Burson-Marsteller Latam. Fernando estudió derecho por la Universidad Autónoma de Madrid y ejerció de periodista en prensa y radio local. Prepare to embrace your inner scientist this summer at the Auchentoshan Taste Experiments - a series of events in London (with more dates to be confirmed) that will help you to understand and analyse your preferences to certain flavours. The events, which aim to add something unique and unusual to a traditional whisky tasting, have been created by Auchentoshan Master Blender and chemist Rachel Barrie, cocktail genius Ryan Chetiyawardana (AKA Mr Lyan), coffee & taste experts DunneFrankowski and food experimentalists Rebel Dining Society.

Auchentoshan pronounced ock-un-tosh-an is an authentic Single Malt with a modern contemporary feel targeted at an emerging, whisky drinking generation. It’s the only distillery to distil three times (rather than once or twice to remove impurities) allowing the liquid to absorb every possible characteristic from the wood as it matures in the finest oak barrels. It’s this unique process that gives it unrivalled smoothness and versatility making it the perfect mixing whisky.

The Auchentoshan Taste Experiments will transport tests usually only explored in the confines of the Master Blender’s laboratory into a fun and interactive environment. The masterclass will take you on a journey: First, an education into taste and flavour; Second, how to taste whisky and customise cocktails and thirdly investigating fermentation, distillation and maturation through food.

The events tap into a growing thirst for experiences that combine the powers of science and imagination. Through this balance of science, craft, fun and flavours the Auchentoshan Taste Experiments will provide a greater understanding of how to appreciate and enjoy Auchentoshan Single Malt Whisky.

Numbers will be limited to 40 per evening to ensure an intimate feel to proceedings.

 

The Taste Experts:

DunneFrankowski - DunneFrankowski, are known as purveyors of fine coffee. They run lively and exciting training and talks and will be hosting the Introduction to Taste.

Ryan Chetiyawardana - The most studious of bartending gentlemen, Mr Ryan Chetiyawardana has recently ended his role as Creative Manager at The Worship Street Whistling Shop bar in East London, where he created arguably one of the most inventive cocktail menus in the world. He is now developing Mr Lyan- a new drinking experience coming very soon.

The Rebel Dining Society - Has established itself as a driving force in the emerging conceptual dining and event scene with their desire to push the boundaries of fine dining. Immersing participants in an atmosphere that stimulates the senses and taste buds alike. 

The Auchentoshan Taste Experiments form part of a wider campaign around experiments, which will see Auchentoshan invite consumers far and wide to explore taste and whisky with experiments online at https://www.facebook.com/auchentoshan

Ticket price Includes:

  • Cocktails & Whisky tasting
  • Tasting plates

Over 21's only.

We advise you arrive from 7pm for a 7.30pm start.

Tickets are non-refundable.

Women are rising through a collective voice of urgency, innovation and ideas... 

Join us for some networking and a casual discussion on how we can yell a little louder here in NY! Plus, the screening of a Kickstarter pitch video for a project aimed at helping young women and girls recognize their full potential through engaging and informative content. 


We'll hear from established women and industry leaders...

  • Red, white and you: Where we need your voice most in politics and public policy. Reshma Saujani -  Democratic Candidate for NY Public Advocate; Co-founder & CEO, Girls Who Code.
  • Changing the world one teen at a time: Reaching the next generation of female leaders. Aria Finger - COO, DoSomething.org
  • Women who code are a special kind of badass: Stories and insights from one of the few. Janet Kasdan - Startup CTO advisor; Former Director of Technology at Conde Naste Digital
  • Bright lights and sound bites: Establishing your voice in the media. Rebecca Jarvis - ABC News Chief Business and Economics Correspondent

And your voice will not go unheard!

All attendees will have the opportunity to share their ideas and solutions for a number of the world's current events - everything from the state of the economy to women's issues to conflicts in the Middle East. These on-camera interviews will be distributed to select media outlets in an effort to shed light on the opportunity cost of leaving half of our country's "voices" out of the dialogue that ultimately becomes a foundation for decisions affecting us all.   

---

THE DETAILS

June 27th, 2013 

5:00-6:00 PM - Arrival and cocktails (Tribeca Grill Gallery)

6:00-8:00 PM - Forum, Q&A + screening of Alley Girls Kickstarter video (Tribeca Film Center Screening Room)

8:00-9:00 PM - Cocktails, hors d'ouevres & networking (Tribeca Grill Gallery)

---


About Alley Girls Voices Forum

Alley Girls Voices Forum is a celebration of the modern women’s movement. Our mothers and grandmothers marched in the streets to rally for women's rights. Today’s generation is also protesting the status quo, but in a different way. Having recognized the progress fought for by the women before them, today’s women are advancing the movement by doing, creating, thinking and speaking their way into business and leadership roles previously reserved for men. The tech industry has proved to be an accessible avenue for women to populate those roles, but there’s still a long road ahead before women break through a system that, by default, caters to men. 

 

We want to use Alley Girls Voices Forum as a platform for educating women about their opportunities to go outside the box as leaders, and to provide them with the tools, people and resources to be change agents themselves. 


We hope you'll join us!

Professionalism, Reflection and Criticism

 

Tuesday 25 June 2013 at the University of Derby

 

The Centre for Educational Research is pleased to announce the fourth annual ‘professionalism’ conference sponsored by the Standing Committee for the Education and Training of Teachers (SCETT)

 

Keynote Speaker: Professor Stephen D. Brookfield

 

Critical Reflections on Reflective Practice

 

“Most practitioners would probably say they support the goal of helping colleagues to think and act more critically and more reflectively.  Rare indeed are those practitioners who would want to be identified as working in an uncritical or unreflective way.  But what acting critically looks like varies considerably depending on your politics, identity and the intellectual traditions you take most seriously.  In this interactive session Stephen Brookfield will take a critical theory perspective on what critical reflection looks like, and will link it to radical, activist traditions”.

 

About Stephen: Since beginning his teaching career in 1970, Stephen has worked in England, Canada, Australia, and the United States, teaching in a variety of college settings. He has written fifteen books on adult learning, teaching, critical thinking, discussion methods and critical theory. Among his publications is the influential bookBecoming A Critically Reflective Teacher which is one of six of his works that have won the Cyril O. Houle World Award for Literature in Adult Education (in 1986, 1989, 1996, 2005, 2011 and 2012). He also won the 1986 Imogene Okes Award for Outstanding Research in Adult Education. His work has been translated into German, Korean, Finnish, Chinese, Japanese, and Polish.

 

Visit his personal web site here.

The Fond du Lac County Fair will celebrate its 162th fair in 2013.

The first fair, held in Rosendale, Wisconsin, began with an address at half past one on the first day, September 29, 1852. The event was held for two days.

Dairy cattle, fine, wool, tools and manufactured items were exhibited at the first fair. Household arts and garden vegetables were on display to be judged.

The best stallion received a $4 premium. Working oxen and steers were awarded $3 for being the best in the class. The best sample of butter, not less than 50 lbs., was awarded $5. The best sample sugar, also not less than 50 lbs., was given a $4 premium.

The theme for the fair "Education, Entertainment and Affordable Family Fun" is the creative genius of Mr. Williard Henken, who retired from the Fond du Lac County Agricultural Society in November of 2001. His background as the first Dean of the University of Wisconsin-Fond du Lac and his love of the fair are certainly reflected in not only the theme, but also in the many years of service he gave to the fair organization.

description:
The Creative Industries Safety Passport

The new health & safety course from BECTU 

 

What is the Creative Industries Safety Passport?

The Creative Industries Safety Passport is a one day health & safety course designed specifically for workers, employed or freelance, working in film, TV, theatre and live events. It promotes a safety culture based on personal responsibility for safety. This means that it encourages delegates to be pro-active in their own safety and the safety of others.  

The course is accredited by the Institution of Occupational Safety & Health (IOSH) under their Passport scheme which is a nationally recognised scheme and follows The Health & Safety Executive (HSE) syllabus guidelines as well Creative Skillset’s National Occupational  Standards in Health & Safety X2, X3 and X3.5 and the BECTU/TMA Code of Conduct for Get-in/ Get-outs. It is a level 2 qualification that is valid for 3 years and comes with a workbook and a robust credit card size ID card with a HoloKote finish which is tamper proof. All Safety Passport holders are registered on the IOSH central database so verification is an easy process. With so many employers asking for proof of health and safety training BECTU is providing an accredited qualification that is relevant to creative industries workers.

What is the course content?

The course covers the basics a delegate needs in health & safety as well as focusing on specific hazards that come up in the creative industries.

 The course is split into 5 modules:

• Introducing creative industry safety; this covers why health & safety matters, health & safety legislation, duties of employees, self employed and contractors under the Health & Safety at Work Act 1974, insurance, safety reps & inspectors

 • Defining hazard and risk; this covers risk assessments-hazards and risks, competence, risk matrix, controlling risk, what is reasonably practicable, dynamic risk assessments & risk perceptions

 • Hazards and practical control measures; this covers electricity, display screen equipment, working at height, manual handling, slips and trips, work equipment, hazardous substances & noise

 • Common workplace measures; this covers working time, welfare, personal protective equipment (PPE), signs and signals, first aid, accidents, accident reporting, driving, stress, violence, lone working, alcohol & drugs and fire & the environment

 • Personal responsibility for safety; this looks at how an individual can make a difference

 The course uses a mix of teaching styles, including video and discussion to enhance the learning experience. Delegates can bring real issues and near miss incidents to increase the relevance of the course. All the trainers are IOSH accredited and have a wealth of knowledge and experience working in the creative industries. 

The course has two assessment papers which both require a seventy percent (70%) pass mark to be eligible to receive a passport. The first is a twenty question written paper with multiple choice and written answers and the second is a spot the hazard risk assessment paper.

Time of course: 9.00am - 5.30pm

 

 Refreshments

Tea and coffee will be available during breaks, lunch will be provided.
name: Creative & Cultural Skills Creative Industries Safety Passport

The Marine Corps League perpetuates the traditions and spirits of ALL Marines and Navy FMF Corpsmen who proudly wear or have worn the eagle, globe, and anchor of the Corps.

It takes great pride in crediting its founding in 1923 to World War I hero, then Major General Commandant John A. LeJeune. It takes equal pride in its Federal Charter, approved by an Act of the Seventy-Fifth Congress of the United States of America and signed and approved by President Franklin D. Roosevelt on August 4, 1937. The League is the only Federally Chartered Marine Corps-related veterans organization in the country. Since its earliest days, the Marine Corps League has enjoyed the support and encouragement of the active duty and Reserve establishments of the     U. S

The Marine Corps League sponsors many programs that benefit:

-     Our Veteran Marines and families,

-     Our serving Marines and families, and

-     Toys for Tots,

DATES & TIMES:
July 26, 27 & 28, 2013
Festival open from 10:00am to 7:00pm (gates close at 6:00pm)

TICKETS:

Discount online tickets available June 1st, 2013 until July 28, 2013 at noon.

Regular ticket prices at the gate:
• Adults (ages 13-59) - $17.00
• Child/Senior (ages 6-12 and 60+) - $8.00
• Children under 6 admitted free with an adult
• Gourmet Alley Combo Plate - $12.00.

Gourmet Alley Combo Plate 1: ½ Peppersteak Sandwich, Calamari, Pasta con Pesto, Garlic Bread.
Gourmet Alley Combo Plate 2: ½ Sausage Sandwich, Scampi, Mushrooms, Garlic Bread.
Combo Plate choice is made at the Festival.

The admission price includes parking, musical entertainment, cooking demonstrations, and a children's area. Food and beverages may be purchased from the vendors. Prices range from $2 to $12 or more depending on the item, which is typically a full-size serving, not a sample.

There are no refunds or exchanges for Gilroy Garlic Festival tickets purchased online. All sales are final.

The festival is held in a park. It is all outdoors with mostly turf and some compact dirt and asphalt walkways. There are natural shade trees, and many shade tents with tables and benches.

Shirt and shoes are required.

Christmas Hill Park rules prohibit bringing the following items on Festival grounds:

  • Alcohol of any kind
  • Bottles, glass and cans
  • Coolers – large or small
  • Frisbees and water projecting devices
  • Pocket knives and weapons of any kind.

Please be advised that the City of Gilroy park rules prohibit dogs and other animals from being brought into the park, except Service Dogs.

The Gilroy Garlic Festival is a celebration of food, fun and family. It is the Garlic Festival's policy to provide a safe, family-friendly atmosphere for all Festival patrons and volunteers. Therefore, the Garlic Festival refuses entry or admission to anyone wearing clothing or paraphernalia indicating or signifying membership in a gang, including a motorcycle club. This policy is applied equally to all persons, regardless of their sex, race, color, religion, ancestry, national origin, disability or medical condition.

CALTRAIN:

The Festival will charter Caltrain to operate one train Saturday July 27, 2013 and one train Sunday July 28, 2013 roundtrip from the San Jose Diridon Caltrain Station to the Gilroy Caltrain Station, non-stop. This special Garlic Festival only train will depart San Jose at 10:06 AM and arrive in Gilroy at 11:00 AM each day. The return train will depart Gilroy at 4:55 PM and arrive in San Jose at 5:45 PM each day. This schedule allows for a 15 minute window for passengers to transfer to and from regular weekend Peninsula Caltrain service north of San Jose. Caltrain tickets for regular service north of San Jose may be purchased from ticket machines at Caltrain stations.

Tickets for this special Garlic Festival Caltrain are available only through this website (). Caltrain does not sell tickets for this train. Purchasing this online ticket for the Garlic Festival Caltrain does not guarantee an available seat on the train. Train may be overbooked resulting in standing room only. Your ticket may only be used on the date shown on the face of the ticket and is not valid any other day. Your Garlic Festival Caltrain ticket includes single day admission to the Gilroy Garlic Festival on the date shown on the ticket, and may also include a Gourmet Alley Combo Plate for an additional fee if selected at time of purchase.

Your ticket includes roundtrip shuttle bus transportation from the Gilroy Caltrain Station to the Garlic Festival. The last shuttle bus will depart the Festival, from the intersection of Uvas Park Drive and Miller Avenue, at 4:15 PM each day to meet the northbound train at the Gilroy Caltrain Station. No alternative transportation and no refunds will be provided by the Gilroy Garlic Festival should you miss the bus or the train. No exceptions.

There are no refunds or exchanges for Gilroy Garlic Festival Caltrain tickets purchased online. All sales are final.

Ticketing FAQs:

I ordered my ticket online, how will I RECEIVE my ticket?
Tickets ordered online are e-tickets. Check your email inbox for your Order Confirmation from . Your e-tickets will be attached to your order confirmation email. Make sure to print them out and bring them to the event. IMPORTANT: if you do not see your order confirmation in your inbox, make sure to check your junk/spam folder.

Do I need to PRINT out my tickets?
YES. Print out your tickets and bring them to the event entrance.

I still don't see my order confirmation, what should I do?
I am having trouble printing my PDF ticket, what should I do?
Please click here for more information on finding your order confirmation or printing your ticket(s). For non-technical ticketing questions or other information about the event click here or call: (408) 842-1625 M-F, 9:00am-5:00pm.

I bought two tickets and they both have my name on them. Will this be a problem?
No. Tickets are transferrable. The name on your ticket only signifies who purchased the tickets. Just make sure the bar code on your ticket(s) are not damaged when you print them out.  If you would like to update the name or email address on your order, click here.

Welcome to the Eighth Annual Bike for the Brain, an event for mental health.

 

Monday, September 2, 2013 (Labor Day)

 

Registration 7:00 am, Start time: 8:00 am.

Johnson County Mental Health Center

6000 Lamar Avenue

Mission, KS 66202

Bike 4 the Brain, a 501(c)(3) organization, hosts an annual community bicycle ride, run and walk event to increase awareness that all people have the potential to recover from mental health disorders; that these are brain-based emotional, behavioral, and cognitive experiences that are common to many people; and to provide funding to Kansas City based organizations that help people to reclaim their mental health.

More than 500 people participated in last years event. We have awarded 21 grants totalling $52,500. We are growing in partnerships, information sharing, and volunteer involvement. Come join us for the fun!

Highlights of this year’s Labor Day event will include:

  • Urban/rural cycling courses of 3, 10, 33, 55, and 72 miles, 8 a.m.
  • Rest stops at mental health agencies and other locations
  • Run 4 Recovery, a non-competitive and untimed 5k fun run/walk, 8:15 a.m.
  • One mile Walk 4 Recovery, 10 a.m.
  • Tricycle Challenge, 10:30 a.m. Adults who donate $100 will pit their child-size tricycle racing skills against one another. Children can race the course at 11 a.m.
  • Recovery Information Exchange where local agencies can share information about mental health topics and the services they provide.  Click here for more information: Bring Your Own Table
  • Delicious refreshments from Panera Bread, Freddy’s Frozen Custard, Whole Foods, and Costco

Visit our home page for more information: www.bikeforthebrain.org

 

B4B Merchandise can be purchased with your event registration.  It can be found at the bottom of the page after clicking "Order Now" above.

This dynamic group based approach is based on a form of systemic therapy called Family constellations, originating from the work of Bert Hellinger.  

It will help you to unpack and break negative generational family patterns and their impact on your life.  This method enables you to quickly penetrate the issues that have summed up your life so far, and applies healing to those negative dynamics around you. 

Sometimes you will find that the pain or issues you’ve been carrying all these years is the pain you’ve unconsciously been given or taken on, on behalf of a family member. 

This process is really very interesting and yet is as simple in approach as it is deep. You don’t have to soul search or interrogate your life, because the method is such that it’s actually like watching the play of your life unfold as others ‘act’ that part of your life.   You could find that by participating in this healing process, tangible shifts begin to take place in your life and amazing things start to happen- you become more of who you really are.

The day will facilitated by:

Amete Hewitt: Self Development Trainer, Family Constellation Facilitator and Counsellor.

Amete will be working from an African cantered perspective, acknowledging the contributions of our ancestors for our servival and for the contributions of the Zulu people of South Africa for helping us remember.

Email: Horizon_training@hotmail.co.uk

 

Places are limited so book soon

JUST ANNOUNCED! 

Kim Lyons, Gunter Schlierkamp, & Daniel Cormier To Host Charity Workout!

Get ready to sweat.

Automatic Body by Nutrié is sponsoring an exciting celebrity workout in conjunction with the  on Saturday, June 8th, at 8AM. Here, training participants will get the chance to work out with celebrity fitness trainer Kim Lyons (from The Biggest Loser, The Dr. Oz Show, and The Dr. Phil Weight Loss Challenge), Gunter Schlierkamp (winner of Mr. Universe) and the undefeated UFC heavy-weight contender Daniel Cormier at Chukchansi Park in Fresno, CA!

This power trio is teaming up with Automatic Body by Nutrié to guide you through a fun and fat blasting workout! To get your sweat on, here’s what you need to bring:

·      Running shoes

·      Water or a can of Energé

·      A donation for The Ronald McDonald House 

This is a great opportunity to support an important cause and get the best workout of your life with the Automatic Body fitness pros! You won’t want to miss this! 

Meet the Automatic Body Celebrity Fitness Team 

Kim Lyons: With over ten years of experience as a personal trainer, Kim Lyons – former trainer on NBC’s hit show, The Biggest Loser and Dr Phil’s Ultimate Weight Loss Challenge – has quickly become an icon in the health and fitness arena. Armed with a positive attitude and a winning smile, she has inspired a nation to achieve their goals of living a happy, healthy lifestyle. Kim is the co-creator of the Automatic Body app notification system and nutritional program.

 

Gunter Schlierkamp: When Gunter was 12 living in Germany, he saw Arnold Schwarzenegger in the film, “Conan The Barbarian”. He was amazed to see how a person could sculpt his body through weight training and at age 16, Gunter finally got the opportunity to start training at a gym for the first time and after two years of training, he won his first competition. In November 1993, Gunter won the heavyweight division at the World Championships, which earned him the “Mr. Universe” title and launched his professional career. In December 1996, Gunter moved to the United States and began his life in America.

 

Daniel Cormier: Cormier began his professional MMA career on September 25, 2009, defeating Gary Frazier. He is undoubtedly one of the best wrestlers in the MMA, if not the best. However, he is also highly athletic, and has developed into a smart and adept striker. Cormier trains at the American Kickboxing Academy (AKA) in San Jose, California, and fights for the Zuffa-owned Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) organization. 

About Ronald McDonald House

 

The mission of Ronald McDonald House Charities (RMHC) is to create, find and support programs that directly improve the health and well being of children.

Guiding in this mission are these core values:

  • Focusing on the critical needs of children.
  • Celebrating the diversity of the programs we offer and the people who make them possible.
  • Staying true to our heritage of 38 years of responsible stewardship.
  • Operating with accountability and transparency.

 

Ronald McDonald House believes that when you change a child’s life, you change a family’s, which can change a community, and ultimately the world.

Why Kim Lyons and Gunter Schlierkamp choose Ronald McDonald House: 

“Gunter and I feel strongly in the importance and understanding that family comes first. The Ronald McDonald House is amazing in not only supporting the medical needs of the children, but also helping the family so they are able to be by their child’s side. It is an amazing charity that we are proud to support! ”

—Kim Lyons            Learn more about Ronald McDonald Charities

Retreat Into Wisdom | Open Invitation

We are living in a world in which many of us are interested in making life the most extraordinary journey possible. We know that the way we communicate with ourselves and with the world around us is crucial for making good use of our unique gifts and natural talents.

Yet, it can be utterly confusing to seek the right wisdom, not knowing what paths to take, especially when attempting to seek wisdom within the midst of mass media productions like the new age movement with its over complicated pathways and even contradictory messages.

I always have valued a 'soothing to the heart’ and welcoming space which I can enter in moments when I feel it is time to seek out pure wisdom that translates into my practical life. I always loved connecting to heart-centered individuals that together aspire to contribute to the world as a family.

Over recent decades I have been fortunate to have received teachings of timeless wisdom from my physical and non-physical mentors who I continue to love very much. In my life, I have always been very blessed to be able to stay close to the source of my authentic truth and heart, and now feel called to further extend my wisdom to the world of wonderful individuals like yourself within a retreat format.

The ‘Retreat Into Wisdom’ is a genuine invitation for individuals who align with this message for us to spend some wonderful hours in a supportive environment once monthly. We will gather to cut through the jargon and mind-clutter of the personal development industry for us to create direction and meaning in a rapidly changing world.

I want to be very clear on the following message. I am NOT a guru, and don’t feel the need to be elevated to such status. When you get to know me, you will realise that I only point to the TRUTH within you. I feel called to guide individuals on their path towards greatness by dusting off the cog-webs that has settled before their very eyes, which partially or fully prevents them from recognising their authentic truth. My gift and offering that I like to extend to you right here is for us as a collective to peel the ‘LAYERS OF LIFE’ back to its origin and essential state, so we once again can live life from our heart.

It is important for me to communicate that I don't have any alignment with any type of religious views, I am actually ANTI-religious. This is my TRUTH and it keeps my doorways open to full-heartedly respect all approaches to life.

Here are two ways you can support my continuous cause to contribute to humanity, as it is what I truly LOVE most. Firstly, the ‘Retreat Into Wisdom’ solely runs on donations ONLY and I therefore are grateful for your willingness to help. Again, feel free right now to SHARE this page with your network of friends, in particular with heart-centered individuals who live in MELBOURNE. I trust your good judgment…

The admission price includes parking, musical entertainment, cooking demonstrations, and a children's area. Food and beverages may be purchased from the vendors. Prices range from $2 to $12 or more depending on the item, which is typically a full-size serving, not a sample.

There are no refunds or exchanges for Gilroy Garlic Festival tickets purchased online. All sales are final.

The festival is held in a park. It is all outdoors with mostly turf and some compact dirt and asphalt walkways. There are natural shade trees, and many shade tents with tables and benches.

Shirt and shoes are required.

Christmas Hill Park rules prohibit bringing the following items on Festival grounds:

  • Alcohol of any kind
  • Bottles, glass and cans
  • Coolers – large or small
  • Frisbees and water projecting devices
  • Pocket knives and weapons of any kind.

Please be advised that the City of Gilroy park rules prohibit dogs and other animals from being brought into the park, except Service Dogs.

The Gilroy Garlic Festival is a celebration of food, fun and family. It is the Garlic Festival's policy to provide a safe, family-friendly atmosphere for all Festival patrons and volunteers. Therefore, the Garlic Festival refuses entry or admission to anyone wearing clothing or paraphernalia indicating or signifying membership in a gang, including a motorcycle club. This policy is applied equally to all persons, regardless of their sex, race, color, religion, ancestry, national origin, disability or medical condition.

CALTRAIN:

The Festival will charter Caltrain to operate one train Saturday July 27, 2013 and one train Sunday July 28, 2013 roundtrip from the San Jose Diridon Caltrain Station to the Gilroy Caltrain Station, non-stop. This special Garlic Festival only train will depart San Jose at 10:06 AM and arrive in Gilroy at 11:00 AM each day. The return train will depart Gilroy at 4:55 PM and arrive in San Jose at 5:45 PM each day. This schedule allows for a 15 minute window for passengers to transfer to and from regular weekend Peninsula Caltrain service north of San Jose. Caltrain tickets for regular service north of San Jose may be purchased from ticket machines at Caltrain stations.

Tickets for this special Garlic Festival Caltrain are available only through this website (). Caltrain does not sell tickets for this train. Purchasing this online ticket for the Garlic Festival Caltrain does not guarantee an available seat on the train. Train may be overbooked resulting in standing room only. Your ticket may only be used on the date shown on the face of the ticket and is not valid any other day. Your Garlic Festival Caltrain ticket includes single day admission to the Gilroy Garlic Festival on the date shown on the ticket, and may also include a Gourmet Alley Combo Plate for an additional fee if selected at time of purchase.

Your ticket includes roundtrip shuttle bus transportation from the Gilroy Caltrain Station to the Garlic Festival. The last shuttle bus will depart the Festival, from the intersection of Uvas Park Drive and Miller Avenue, at 4:15 PM each day to meet the northbound train at the Gilroy Caltrain Station. No alternative transportation and no refunds will be provided by the Gilroy Garlic Festival should you miss the bus or the train. No exceptions.

There are no refunds or exchanges for Gilroy Garlic Festival Caltrain tickets purchased online. All sales are final.

www.gilroygarlicfestival.com

DATES & TIMES:
July 26, 27 & 28, 2013
Festival open from 10:00am to 7:00pm (gates close at 6:00pm)

TICKETS:

Discount online tickets available June 1st, 2013 until July 28, 2013 at noon.

Regular ticket prices at the gate:
• Adults (ages 13-59) - $17.00
• Child/Senior (ages 6-12 and 60+) - $8.00
• Children under 6 admitted free with an adult
• Gourmet Alley Combo Plate - $12.00.

Gourmet Alley Combo Plate 1: ½ Peppersteak Sandwich, Calamari, Pasta con Pesto, Garlic Bread.
Gourmet Alley Combo Plate 2: ½ Sausage Sandwich, Scampi, Mushrooms, Garlic Bread.
Combo Plate choice is made at the Festival.

The admission price includes parking, musical entertainment, cooking demonstrations, and a children's area. Food and beverages may be purchased from the vendors. Prices range from $2 to $12 or more depending on the item, which is typically a full-size serving, not a sample.

There are no refunds or exchanges for Gilroy Garlic Festival tickets purchased online. All sales are final.

The festival is held in a park. It is all outdoors with mostly turf and some compact dirt and asphalt walkways. There are natural shade trees, and many shade tents with tables and benches.

Shirt and shoes are required.

Christmas Hill Park rules prohibit bringing the following items on Festival grounds:

  • Alcohol of any kind
  • Bottles, glass and cans
  • Coolers – large or small
  • Frisbees and water projecting devices
  • Pocket knives and weapons of any kind.

Please be advised that the City of Gilroy park rules prohibit dogs and other animals from being brought into the park, except Service Dogs.

The Gilroy Garlic Festival is a celebration of food, fun and family. It is the Garlic Festival's policy to provide a safe, family-friendly atmosphere for all Festival patrons and volunteers. Therefore, the Garlic Festival refuses entry or admission to anyone wearing clothing or paraphernalia indicating or signifying membership in a gang, including a motorcycle club. This policy is applied equally to all persons, regardless of their sex, race, color, religion, ancestry, national origin, disability or medical condition.

CALTRAIN:

The Festival will charter Caltrain to operate one train Saturday July 27, 2013 and one train Sunday July 28, 2013 roundtrip from the San Jose Diridon Caltrain Station to the Gilroy Caltrain Station, non-stop. This special Garlic Festival only train will depart San Jose at 10:06 AM and arrive in Gilroy at 11:00 AM each day. The return train will depart Gilroy at 4:55 PM and arrive in San Jose at 5:45 PM each day. This schedule allows for a 15 minute window for passengers to transfer to and from regular weekend Peninsula Caltrain service north of San Jose. Caltrain tickets for regular service north of San Jose may be purchased from ticket machines at Caltrain stations.

Tickets for this special Garlic Festival Caltrain are available only through this website (). Caltrain does not sell tickets for this train. Purchasing this online ticket for the Garlic Festival Caltrain does not guarantee an available seat on the train. Train may be overbooked resulting in standing room only. Your ticket may only be used on the date shown on the face of the ticket and is not valid any other day. Your Garlic Festival Caltrain ticket includes single day admission to the Gilroy Garlic Festival on the date shown on the ticket, and may also include a Gourmet Alley Combo Plate for an additional fee if selected at time of purchase.

Your ticket includes roundtrip shuttle bus transportation from the Gilroy Caltrain Station to the Garlic Festival. The last shuttle bus will depart the Festival, from the intersection of Uvas Park Drive and Miller Avenue, at 4:15 PM each day to meet the northbound train at the Gilroy Caltrain Station. No alternative transportation and no refunds will be provided by the Gilroy Garlic Festival should you miss the bus or the train. No exceptions.

There are no refunds or exchanges for Gilroy Garlic Festival Caltrain tickets purchased online. All sales are final.

Ticketing FAQs:

I ordered my ticket online, how will I RECEIVE my ticket?
Tickets ordered online are e-tickets. Check your email inbox for your Order Confirmation from . Your e-tickets will be attached to your order confirmation email. Make sure to print them out and bring them to the event. IMPORTANT: if you do not see your order confirmation in your inbox, make sure to check your junk/spam folder.

Do I need to PRINT out my tickets?
YES. Print out your tickets and bring them to the event entrance.

I still don't see my order confirmation, what should I do?
I am having trouble printing my PDF ticket, what should I do?
Please click here for more information on finding your order confirmation or printing your ticket(s). For non-technical ticketing questions or other information about the event click here or call: (408) 842-1625 M-F, 9:00am-5:00pm.

I bought two tickets and they both have my name on them. Will this be a problem?
No. Tickets are transferrable. The name on your ticket only signifies who purchased the tickets. Just make sure the bar code on your ticket(s) are not damaged when you print them out.  If you would like to update the name or email address on your order, click here.

org_desc:
The LBC is a statewide association of over 1,600 Baptist churches connected through a common mission.  These churches minister both separately and cooperatively to reach our common goal -- to help every person find help, hope and encouragement in the midst of a busy world.

The LBC churches are connected with more than 40,000 other Southern Baptist Churches throughout the United States. This is a voluntary network with ministry in more than 105 countries worldwide.

The LBC state offices are located at 1250 MacArthur Drive, Alexandria, Louisiana.


Louisiana Baptist Convention Mission & Vision

MISSION STATEMENT:

The LBC exists to serve the Baptist churches in Louisiana as:

  • a catalyst for igniting a passion for Jesus and His kingdom,
  • a consultant for strengthening the congregations, and
  • a conduit for accomplishing cooperative missions

VISION STATEMENT:

Our vision is to ignite a passion for Jesus among Louisiana Baptists that will result in dynamic, growing congregations who covenant together to extend the kingdom of God to the ends of the earth.
