For the un-Initiated.


Chef David Santos and Chef Russell Jackson with a mind to collaborate and create a unique dining expierence born from their underground roots, Philosophies and common love and respect of modern cuisine.

Before opening his own restaurant, Santos established his own culinary voice by launching Um Segredo, a series of supper clubs hosted at his Roosevelt Island home, which quickly developed a cult following.

The Portuguese word “Louro” means bay leaf, and it embodies the restaurant that Santos has dreamed about for years.


Subculture: an ethnic, regional, economic, or social group exhibiting characteristic patterns of behavior sufficient to distinguish it from others within an embracing culture or society.


Revolution: a sudden, radical, or complete change, activity or movement designed to effect fundamental changes in the socioeconomic situation, a fundamental change in the way of thinking about or visualizing something : a change of paradigm.


Evolution: a process of gradual and relatively peaceful social, political, and economic advance, a process in which the whole universe is a progression of interrelated phenomena.


Born from necessity, the mother of inspired creation. SubCulture Dining came to existence in 2005 with an original mandate to move from the darkness of obscurity to the light of permanence in the encampment known as “Lafitte” on the San Francisco Waterfront. What was originally a simple idea of active growth had become a movement. One that has given birth, motivation and inspiration to others around the world.


Our history is long, well documented, castigated, lauded, falsified, rejected and embraced. We’ve fought through obscurity, broken rules and theories to become a viable entity that had relevance in the culinary community. What we found in the wake of our practices were the lives we touched, the changes to the industry and food movements that we inspired. By no means do we make claims to take credit for the larger picture, we played a small role in pushing boundaries, and rejecting conventional thought.


This is what we’ve found is our core, and this is what we stand for. “The Rejection of Dystopian Culinary Convention.”


Quietly resting and resurrecting, finding its heart and renewing a new mandate. SubCulture Dining makes it return to active subversive operations. Older, wiser, evolved. More than any other time in history, we’re facing culinary oppression on multiple fronts. It’s our position that I hope to bring conversation, action and evolution to the new paradigm.. Led by the Dissident Chef and his Crew of Rōnin.


“The rEvolution will now be televised.”

description:
A documentary in which Freda Kelly looks back at her career as lifelong secretary for The Beatles.

Freda Kelly was just a shy Liverpudlian teenager when she was asked to work for a local band hoping to make it big. Though she had no concept of how far they would go, Freda had faith in The Beatles from the beginning, and The Beatles had faith in her. History notes that The Beatles were together for 10 years, but Freda worked for them for 11. Many people came in and out of the band's circle as they grew to international stardom, but Freda remained a staple because of her unfaltering loyalty and dedication. As the Beatles' devoted secretary and friend, Freda was there as history unfolded; she was witness to the evolution - advances and setbacks, breakthroughs and challenges - of the greatest band in history. In GOOD OL' FREDA, Freda tells her stories for the first time in 50 years. One of few films with the support of the living Beatles and featuring original Beatles music, the film offers an insider perspective on the beloved band that changed the music industry.
name: GOOD OL’ FREDA

description:
How Bill Rasmussen Forever Changed The Way We Watch TV

Bill Rasmussen is the face of the all-American entrepreneurial start-up story.

During 1978, Bill found himself unemployed from his job as communication director for the New England Whalers. However, 14 months after Bill was fired, he changed the world of television forever with the idea of ESPN, the first 24-hour sports network.

Reaching the goal was not an easy feat though, which every entrepreneur can relate to. Bill met with countless cable operators and financial backers, who all expressed disbelief in Bill’s dream. But with his determination in tow, Bill turned cynics into supporters with an NCAA contract and a million-dollar advertisement with Anheuser-Busch.

Flash-forward to present day and ESPN reaches over 200 countries and hundreds of millions of U.S. televisions. Today, Bill is regarded as the George Washington of ESPN, which is an inspiring, life-changing story for business owners who are driven to forever change their industries.

In this rare intimate interview between Bill and Lewis Schiff, Council Executive Director, here’s your chance to discover how you can apply Bill’s lessons of success into your own business venture.


CEOs & Business Owners: After this intimate discussion, you are invited to attend a special recognition reception for the Inc. 5000 honorees in the same venue. We will have a jazz trio, wine tasting and appetizers while you mingle with some of the top business owners in the Bay Area.

The Hear from the founders, learn from their experience and get insight on what it takes to build a startup on the national scene.

John Schnipkoweit, Chris Quartier, Alex Frazier, and Nick Silhacek entered the elite Nike+ Accelerator program as RecBob earlier this year. One of 10 startups chosen from 3000 applicants globally, they lived in Portland, OR for three months and got exclusive access to the plans, product and data systems for Nike's Fuelband. With this access and 300+ conversations with top mentors and successful entrepreneurs, the team decided to make a major pivot and create NextStep.io.








This intensive small group session will focus on their experience, insights and lessons learned in the process of building a company from the idea stage, attracting investors, getting accepted to a top accelerator and then making the difficult decision to pivot.

  • Hear the team's biggest take-a-ways from the accelerator experience.
  • Learn what it takes to get into a top accelerator program and if it's worth it.
  • Understand the process and experience the team went through to stop working on their original idea (which they had invested in completely for year and a half) and switch their focus.
  • Get insight on the most important things to focus on are when building a startup.
  • Discuss how entrepreneurs in the Corridor can build the opportunities other startups benefit from in more startup-dense regions.

Guru Dudu celebrates Melbourne's music capital as part of the Darebin Music Festival. He will take you on a journey around the streets of Northcote, Preston and Reservoir with spontaneous disco and funny anecdotes! Come along for this hilarious walking-dancing disco tour of the street, surrounds and maybe some spontaneous visits into some music venues

Guru Dudu is Melbourne’s coolest new tour guide - famous for creating 'Happy Yoga' - a unique mix of Yoga and Disco. On the disco walking tour the Guru will take you through with a witty commentary about Northcote against an uplifting dance track from the the 70’s and 80’s.

Think Interpretative Dance and Spontaneous Flash-Mob! Wireless headsets are supplied and you are invited to join in with the kooky antics of the crowd or simply listen in and watch the hilarity unfold.


WHAT TO WEAR

Please come light-handed as we will be on the move a lot. Wear comfortable dancing shoes.

For the Extroverts, dress-up to stand out! There will be lots of opportunities for you to show off your crazy moves in public. For the Introverts, there is no pressure to join in, but be warned, the lure of the Silent Disco is very contagious.

 

DON'T BE LATE

Aim to arrive 15 minutes early to get your headset sorted and start to 'vibe-in'.

Once we leave the starting point, you may miss the tour if you are late.


LOCATION

Meet outside Preston Town Hall. We will tour around High St, the markets and surrounds and return to the Town Hall at the finish.


TICKET PRICES

$10 - discounted due to sponsorship from the local business association

N.B. Tours can be cancelled at 24 hours notice if bookings are too low. This only happens occasionally, in which case you will be informed via email and your money refunded.

 

OTHER TOURS

 

For other tours in the Darebin Music Feast series, click here

 

WEATHER CONTINGUENCY

If the weather is showery, the disco will go ahead - we will duck for cover and choose dry places to dance. In the event of a cancellation due to extreme weather, all tickets will be refunded.


UPCOMING DATES

This talk, by mindfulness teacher and clinical psychologist Patrick Jones, combines modern mindfulness training with ancient methods of spiritual enquiry, to develop both psychological health and the realisation of one's true nature.

Through a unique Clear Mind/Open Heart approach Patrick reveals how non-judgemental thoughts combined with authentic emotions brings about an awareness of the observer within, to create lasting peace of mind and happiness.

Join Patrick for an interactive and liberating session of mindfulness mastery.

Details

  • Presentation starts at 6.45pm – 7.45pm
  • Trenaman Library, Wesley College, Perth

org_desc:
Hello, my name is Meredith Forder. I am the Founder & CEO of Clear Thinking, an organisation dedicated to helping people reduce anxiety, gain mental composure and achieve their highest potential.

I established Clear Thinking with the sole aim of helping others overcome their worries and anxieties by introducing them to a life-saving tool, which is their ability to manage their own mind.

We all have the ability to keep our mind calm, focused and within our control. We just need to learn how and practice it.

When our mind is calm and focused, we can think clearly, reason things out, solve problems and decide what actions we need to take. Basically, when we can manage our mind we can manage anything in life. But when our mind is troubled, disturbed or distracted in any way, it is impossible to think, no matter how intelligent we are.

Therefore, to be “switched on” and present exactly when we need to be is a powerful tool in today’s fast-paced, always-on, distraction-filled world.

If you have any questions or if you would like to book me for a presentation or consultation, then please contact me on 0414 321 877 or meredith @ clearthinking.org.au. I’d be happy to speak with you.

About the GDC

The Society of Graphic Designers of Canada (GDC) is a member-based organization of design professionals, educators, administrators, students and associates in communications, marketing, media and design related fields.

Since 1956, the GDC has been an advocate, voice and resource for Canada’s graphic design profession. We are the national certifying body, licensing the CGD certification mark in association with graphic design services, promoting high standards of visual design and ethical business practices for the benefit of Canadian industry, commerce, public service and education. Through the media, publications, seminars, events, conferences and exhibits, the GDC builds awareness of graphic design and its essential role in business and society.

GDC chapters help designers keep on top of changes in the profession, legal, ethical, technological topics, professional issues, current trends, and innovations.

The GDC has more than 1,300 members in 9 chapters across Canada and members at large nationally and internationally. In addition to our professional members, we are also lucky to have several hundred student members. Find out how you can be part of Canada’s foremost graphic design association.

If you run teen programs, you won't want to miss the chance to bring your teen group (however big or small) to this annual regional event hosted by the Southern California Teen Coalition. 

On Friday, October 4th we invade Pacific Park at the Santa Monica Pier - last year we had just under 1,000 teens and we want to break that number this year!  Ticket price includes: admission to Pacific Park and unlimited ride wristband, dinner, access to Roctober VIP tent with LOTS of fun activities, as well access to VIP DJ Party. Chaperones will check the groups in, leave a onsite contact number for event oranizers and be responible for their groups following the rules of Pacific Park. Any teens caught breaking the rules will be asked to leave the event (with their entire group). So, let's keep it safe and fun. Get crazy - but on the dance floor with your moves!

Tiny Tots Riding and Horse Care Class is a parent/child interactive class which introduces children ages 3-6 to the sport of horseback riding and horse care. The class is designed to be highly interactive with adult for safety and for fun! ½ of the class is geared towards learning to care for horses through grooming, hoof care, and farm chores and ½ of the class is geared towards riding. The riding portion focuses on proper posture and getting comfortable on horseback through hand led rides. Children at this age do not have the motor skills and focus to correctly rein and control the horse, therefore, the adult and instructor have the horse on a lead line with spotter to safely lead the children around while teaching the basics of riding. There is a limit of 4 children per class. Children must be under 50 lbs. to ride as the horses are only 30 inches tall. Closed toed shoes for rider and adult are required.

In case of inclement weather, rain out dates are Sunday’s from 1:00-4:00. Classes will be cancelled by 8:00 a.m. on the day of class and will be listed on facebook.com/halfpinthorses

La définition de l’art populaire

Pendant longtemps, le terme « art populaire » fut doté d’une signification péjorative faisant référence à une certaine masse inculte du peuple. Bien qu’il soit aujourd’hui mieux considéré, il n’a rien perdu de son ambiguïté, et tous ne s’entendent pas sur ce qu’il désigne.

En effet, l'art populaire peut se confondre avec l'art brut ou l'art naïf, notamment parce qu'il commence à peine à s'inscrire dans le circuit de l'art établi. De plus, ces formes d’art ont en commun la quasi-absence de formation artistique de leurs auteurs. Il existe toutefois certains critères qui permettent de déterminer si une œuvre peut être classée ou non dans les arts populaires.

Ainsi, on peut considérer comme issues de l’art populaire des œuvres : qui sont réalisées à l’aide de matériaux ou de techniques traditionnelles ; qui proviennent de la tradition orale; qui sont créées par un individu ou un groupe appartenant à la classe dite populaire d’une société (non érudite dans la pratique de son art) ; qui sont la manifestation de traits culturels ethniques.

description:
Please join us for our first luncheon program of the 2013-2014 year. 

Speaker:  Steven Greiner, Director of Risk Research, FactSet

Topic: Expected Returns & Risks: Broadening Perspectives On Investment Decision Making

Could better forecasting of estimated returns have helped avoid bad decision making during the global crises? How can you combine analyses of expected returns and expected risks when constructing your portfolio?  Dr. Greiner will demonstrate the relationship  between expected returns and expected risks using FactSet’s returns based modelling tools, discuss current forecasting methods, and explore how, combined with stress testing, a returns based approach to risk management can add value to your long term investment strategy in a multi-asset class risk determination.

Bio: Steven Greiner Ph.D. was the senior quantitative strategist and portfolio manager for Allegiant Asset Management (now wholly owned by PNC Capital Advisors) where he was a member of its Investment Committee. Prior to this, Steven served as senior quantitative strategist for large capitalization investments at Harris Investment Management. He has over 20 years of quantitative and modeling experience beginning in the sciences, industry, and finance. Currently Steven is the Director of Risk Research for FactSet Research Systems.

Steven received his BS in mathematics and chemistry from the University of Buffalo and his MS and PhD in physical chemistry from the University of Rochester, and attained postdoctoral experience from the Free University Berlin, Department of Physics. Steven is the author of several scientific publications and the recent books by Wiley, “Ben Graham was a Quant”, April 2011 and “Investment Risk and Uncertainty”, April 2013. He speaks at many conferences around the world and is a frequent writer of FactSet’s Risk Blog and sits on the Advisory board of the Journal of Portfolio Management.
name: CFA Rochester September Luncheon Program

description:
Up until roughly 100 years ago, the government played very little role in the economy.  It was generally believed that the economy worked best when directed by the autonomous forces of supply and demand.  During the 18th and 19th Centuries, a consensus emerged on how the Capitalist economy worked; and that classical economic theory has been the foundation of economic teaching ever since. 

The economy no longer works the way it did during the 19th Century, however.  Over the past 100 years the government's involvement in the economy has expanded so radically that the economic system itself has little left in common with Capitalism - at least, not at the Macro level.  Yet Economics continues to be taught as if nothing has changed; and, for the most part, the public continues to believe that our economy is still driven by natural forces as it always was in the past.  But that is very far from the truth.  

Today, the government manages - or directs - the economy using a variety of policy tools to ensure that Gross Domestic Product continues to expand.  The implications of this fact are very far reaching.  It is impossible to understand politics or economics in our era without grasping that the government is managing the economy.  Moreover, it is particularly important that investors understand this new reality because government actions now impact the direction of asset prices far more than any other variable.

This Course explains how the economy really works.
name: How The Economy Really Works

description:
Didier Chenu expose son univers onirique au Musée de la palmeraie à Marrakech.

 
Vernissage le 1er Juin 2013 à 19h00
 
A propos de l'artiste, par Jacques Meunier:  
 
Chenu a un onirisme à la Prévert ou s'associent la craie, les encres, l'acrylique, et quelquefois des cartes postales, des billets de banque, des Jocondes de récupération, des bagues de cigares ou un lambeau de jute, une vision hypnagogique du monde!
Le dictionnaire dit à hypnagogique: hallucination qui précède ou qui suit immédiatement le sommeil...
 
Un jour, j'ai comparé Chenu à Robot, le fameux chien qui a découvert la grotte de Lascaux. Il y a chez lui du flair, de l'instinct, de la chance, mais aussi un sentiment d'innocence néolithique. Il réinvente la peinture en la faisant. Il marche sur les toits avec la grâce du somnambule et vient mettre un peut d'euphorie sur les murs de nos maisons. 
 
Chenu a de l'Afrique dans la tête. C'est sûr, le cycliste qui traverse la toile ressemble, à s'y méprendre, à ces personnages endimanchés qui parcourent les déserts à dos de bicyclette avec un parapluie noir en guise d'ombrelle. Les soleils sont volés aux graffitis et aux dessins de trottoir. Les femmes sont souvent empruntées à des magazines illustrés. Une approche plus fine, cependant, permet d'échapper à l'anecdote: Chenu met en scène des rêves éveillés et cela résonne en nous comme un Koan. Riante devinette cosmique, De fait, les "poèmes peints" de Chenu ne s'expliquent pas ils sont, avec l'évidence des idées simples qui ne pensent pas.
name: Didier Chenu

D'ailleurs, un parcours ludique en herbe interactif en QR Code (code-barre à lire avec son smartphone pour avoir des infos) vous invite à venir à bout des secrets du jardin et découvrir les contes et légendes autour de sa muse : la tortue.

Le programme de l'été :

Atelier en famille "Prends-en de la graine"
Les petits botanistes en herbe sont invités à composer leurs "boules de graines" dans le mini-labo mobile (une brouette customisée), dans le jardin. Ces boulettes pourront ensuite être disséminés dans la ville.
Tous les week-ends de juin et de septembre, puis tous les jours en juillet et août de 15h à 17h

Les pratiques amateurs
Cet été, prenez le temps de venir vous initier à des pratiques sportives ou artistiques diverses prodigués par des associations confirmés. C'est le tour du monde des activités qui vous est proposé cette année.
Les samedis 15 et 22 juin et 13 et 27 juillet de 15h à 18h

Le Jardin des contes
Venez suivre l’histoire depuis sa racine en écoutant les récits des conteurs du musée. Qu’elles viennent des étendues désertiques du Sahara, des jardins de thé des versants de l’Himalaya ou des forêts tropicales d’Amazonie, ces histoires vous racontent les liens mystérieux qui unissent les hommes et les plantes.
Gratuit dans la limite des places disponibles, tous les week-ends, de 14h0 à 15h

Les livres nomades
En suivant les sentiers qui traversent le jardin des mousses et longent le théâtre de verdure, vous accéderez à une entrée secrète du salon de lecture. Ici, une sélection d’ouvrages autour des thématiques du Jardin d’été est à votre disposition : vous pourrez les emprunter le temps d’une pause lecture dans le jardin.
En accès libre du 15 juin au 18 août

Jeux sous la roseraie
Des jeux venus des 4 continents attendent petits et grands sous la roseraie tels que Fanorona de Magagascar ou encore Bagh Chal du Népal...

Lectures
Des lectures par un duo français-congolais pontuent l'été des visiteurs du jardin. Différents genres littéraires sont abordés (roman, poésie, nouvelles, théâtre...) pour découvrir des auteurs du monde entier. Et si vous voulez vous lancer, des initiations de lecture à voix haute vous sont ouvertes.
- Lecture à voix haute samedi 13 juilletet dimanche 4 août à 14h30
- Initiation de lecture à voix haute dimanche 23 juin, samedi 13 juillet et dimanche 4 août à 15h30
- Entrée libre et gratuite dans la limite des places disponibles, réservationsalondelecture@quaibranly.fr

Siestes électroniques
Venez faire la sieste en écoutant des DJ sets exclusifs réunissant à chaque fois deux artistes. Pour cette occasion, la médiathèque du musée ouvre aux DJs invités sa collection de musiques venant des 4 coins du monde.
Dimanche 7, 14, 21 et 28 juillet de 16h à 18h

Un week-end en Corée
Cette année, le musée du quai Branly accueille une programmation exceptionnelle dans le cadre de Paris Quartier d'été, avec les groupes Be-Being et Noreum Machi.
Accès libre dans la limite des places disponibles les vendredi 19, samedi 20 et dimanche 21 juillet
Théâtre de verdure, jardin du musée

Bref, un joli programme pour se détendre et s'amuser, le tout sans un rond, c'est tout bénéf.

Du 15 juin au 15 septembre 2013

description:
The Atkinson Professional Accounting Association (APAA) is a student-run organization that serves to encourage leadership, excellence, and professionalism in School of Administrative Studies Accounting students of York University. The association was founded in May 1998 by a group of graduating students for the purposes of promoting Atkinson’s Bachelor of Administrative Studies in Accounting (BAS) program, aiding students and soliciting support from University faculty and potential employers. Formerly known as the Atkinson Accounting Club, the association has successfully re-branded itself since 2007.

The majority of APAA members are School of Administrative Studies students who are working toward their Bachelor of Administrative Studies degree and are interested in a career in accounting. Upon graduation, many APAA members pursue a professional accounting designation.

The objectives of the APAA are:

  1. To provide business students an opportunity to interact with accounting firms and organizations.
  2. To facilitate a successful annual recruiting season by providing a networking channel between accounting students and recruiters from public accounting firms and professional organizations.
  3. To actively contribute to and create greater student relations within the York University and School of Administrative Studies community.
  4. To give students the opportunity to seek advice and mentorship from their fellow members and alumni while engaging in our Volunteer Leadership program
  5. To motivate students to be better citizens and leaders in their community.

ЯНТРА ГАНЕШИ. МАСТЕР КЛАСС

Рисование Янтры – это особый вид медитации, способ познания себя и мира через сакральную геометрию, а также метод решенияпроблем в жизни.

ЯНТРА - это символ, графическое изображение определенной божественной энергии. Это означает, что в каждой янтре присутствует определенное божество, как один из аспектов Безграничного. ГАНЕША – это божество, устраняющее препятствия на нашем пути, как духовном, так и материальном. Для Ганеши нет непосильной задачи, он может ВСЕ.

Слово «Янтра» происходит от корня ЯМ или ЯН, означающего«поддерживать, удерживать» и слога ТРА обозначающего«освобождение от уз». Соответственно, янтра обозначает то, что сохраняет сущность и освобождает. В более широком смысле слово янтра означает «инструмент». Инструмент, который помогает выйти за рамки обычного образа мышления и перейти к измененному состоянию сознания.

Когда мы просто смотрим на янтру, наше внимание концентрируется, ум успокаивается, и энергия определенного божественного начала активизируются в нашем сознании. Когда же мы рисуем янтру, мы идем еще глубже. Кода мы творим форму божества, то сонастраиваемся с этой энергией, проникая и постигая ее суть, открывая в себе ее силу и качества. Мы сами становимся открытым каналом для этой божественной энергии.

РИСОВАНИЕ ЯНТРЫ – это медитация и сонастройка с энергиями Вселенной. Мы словно приглашаем эти энергии свободно течь через нас. Рисуя янтру Ганеши, мы устраняем препятствия на своем пути. Эта янтра может стать вашим защитным талисманом, а так же решить конкретную задачу: понять то, что никак не удается, сдвинуть застрявшую ситуацию с места или стать благословлением на начало нового дела.

На занятии мы:

• Познакомимся с элементами сакральной геометрии

• Разберем составляющие элементы на примере янтры Ганеши.

• Нарисуем и раскрасим янтру Ганеши.

• Помедитируем с мантрой Ганеши на свою янтру.

 

Мы подготовим все необходимое для рисования янтры Ганеши. Если вам хочется, возьмите свой простой карандаш, плотный лист бумаги, линейку, циркуль, акварельные карандаши и резинку.

Занятия проводит Виктория Даракова. Имеет высшее медицинское и MBA образование. Изучает Ведические знания и практикует йогу с 1995 года. Автор книги «Гармония дома. Васту шастра».

description:
Imaginez 430 exposants venus de toute la France pour dévoiler de simples bibelots aux pièces les plus rares pendant 5 jours, c'est la fameuse Foire Internationale aux Antiquités de Barjac, dans leGard. Ce village de 1401 habitants reçoit des centaines de visiteurs passionnés de brocantetous les ans pour le week-end de Pâques et du 15 août. La foire aux antiquités et à la brocante de Barjac rassemble aussi bien des collectionneurs aguerris que des simples curieux, tous venus pour la même chose : trouver des bonnes affaires !

Le décor de Barjac se prête harmonieusement à cette grande brocante. Réputée pour son élégance, Barjac est une cité Renaissance située entre les gorges de l'Ardèche et de la Cèze. Deux fois par an, le village troque son ambiance tranquille contre une effervescence qui contamine la population entière !

La foire de Barjac demeure le rendez-vous le plus incontournable du calendrier des brocantes. Il fait étrangement écho aux foires médiévales qui donnaient vie au village. C'était encore le temps où le château représentait la puissance de Barjac.

Dès l'arrivée à Barjac, on est agréablement surpris par son côté pittoresque. Le village propose également de nombreuses activités qui tournent autour de son patrimoine comme les visites guidées des sites historiques : les grottes, les Dolmens, la sépulture mégalithique...

C'est certain, votre séjour dans une location de vacances à Barjac vous fera renouer avec les grands espaces. Vous pourrez vous lancer dans de belles balades sur les sentiers de randonnéequi mènent vers la Vallée de la Cèze, la réserve naturelle de l'Ardèche ou encore le Parc National des Cévennes. Si vous venez à la brocante de Barjac en août, n'oubliez pas de vous garder un moment pour vous rafraîchir à Vallon-Pont d'Arc, un endroit rêver pour la baignade.
name: La Foire aux Antiquités de Barjac

  • Understand the Unsolicited Electronic Messages Act 2007 and its Amendments:  what you can and cannot do according to NZ law;
  • Professional tips - discover what you need to know when it comes to creating email campaigns;
  • Google - free tools that help get you found on the internet - even if you don't have a website.
  • plus much, much more!

Bonus 

Unlike many other seminars you've probably attended where you end up taking lots of notes but implementing nothing because you don't know where to start or don't have the time, Julie South has invited leading Waikato business coach and success strategist Jennifer Myers to show you how to:

  • construct a social media posting plan you can stick to that will get you results;
  • learn how to structure an effective email marketing campaign; and
  • identify which email campaign recipients are qualified prospects and how to turn those into sales.

Presenters

Julie South is the Social Media Coach and locum marketing manager for many New Zealand businesses.  

She regularly shows clients how to easily grow their Facebook fanbase by hundreds of percent (sometimes overnight!) with targeted fans without resorting to Facebook ads.  

She also regularly shows clients how to save thousands of dollars a year through smart email marketing, plus lots more.  

Julie's known for explaining things in simple English so that even non-"social" or computer literate people understand what she's on about.

Here's what others have said about some of her recent workshops:

"Great content, practical and straight-to-the-point. Great presenter, very knowledgeable"

"I liked the behind-the-scenes workings ... how to prioritise effectively ... and especially about Google"

"Prior to attending I really didn't know much about Linkedin or how it could benefit me. I can now see the value and have a plan going forward"

"it was an awesome presentation Julie.  I've been thinking of doing videos for a long time but wasn't sure whether they were right for my business - now I know what to do so will surely get on with it!"


Jennifer Myers is a specialist at helping her SME clients take their business to the 'next level' - whatever the next level looks like for that SME.  

She is a sought-after keynote speaker and has shared business-building tips and strategies with hundreds of SMEs all over New Zealand over the past three years.

One of Jennifer's strengths is her ability to communicate complicated concepts in an easy-to-understand fashion.  She is energetic, knowledgeable and engaging. She'll share tools you can take away from this seminar that will empower you to implement what you've learned.

Here's what others have said about some of Jennifer's recent workshops:

"I am new to running a business and Jennifer's presentation allowed me to see things better"

"Jennifer's presentation gave me some easy to implement solutions / ideas / areas to focus on"

"Jennifer's presentation allowed me to identify what I need to do to make my business better"

 

FAQs

Where can I contact the organiser with any questions?

All of Julie South's and HaloBiz's contact details are listed on this page for your convenience.

Is my registration/ticket transferrable?

Yes it is.  Absolutely!  We understand that sometimes life gets in the way and things happen which prevent you from attending.  In the event you want to gift your ticket to someone else please let us know and we'll arrange for this to happen.

Do I have to bring my printed ticket to the event?

Yes please - it makes the check-in process easier :-)

What is the refund policy?

In the unfortunate event you need to cancel your attendance, your ticket will be refunded in full (less all third-party transaction and administration fees) until 5pm Thursday, 26 September 2013.  After that date you may transfer your attendance from this evento onto another HaloBiz event of your choice.

The name on the registration/ticket doesn't match the attendee. Is that okay?

Of course!  

We realise that despite best intentions, sometimes life just gets in the way.  We'll welcome your substitute with a smile - just as if we were greeting you :-)

I don't consider myself 'computer literate' at all.  How advanced do my computer & social media skills need to be? 

You don't need to be computer literate at all.  Provided you can navigate around a keyboard you'll be fine! Julie's a great believer that there's no such thing as a dumb question.  She knows from experience that if one person has a question it's probable they're not alone in their quandry.  Her teaching style is "ask all the questions you want!".

a streetcar concert with

The Carolines

Chloe Albert  -  Lesley Pelletier  -  Katie Perman

Thursday, September 12 – 8pm 

 

A phenomenal Edmonton vocalist trio:
Chloe Albert, Lesley Pelletier, and Katie Perman, like to rock out in three-part harmony mostly to country classics from Patsy Cline, Loretta Lynn, Hank Williams, and many more. They met in the ol' college days and have been rocking Edmonton's music scene both as solo artists and as a trio since then.  

These girls do stunning harmonies. And we mean really s.t.u.n.n.i.n.g. harmonies.
Read more on their website. Watch this video or this one. 

Imagine all this high on a bridge, in an old streetcar, surrounded by sky and sunset and river views. What more do you want on a late summer evening? Good natured streetcar drivers in uniform? We have those as well! 

Our trip starts at 8pm sharp, so please arrive by 7.45. Meet at the back of the Arts Barns by the tracks, 10330 84 Avenue. The streetcar will take us to the high-level bridge and stop right in the middle of it for a first set of music and wonderful views of the grand North Saskatchewan and the river valley. After crossing the river and a little break we return for a second stop on the bridge with more music.

TIX: There are only 32 tickets. They cost $30 each (breakdown: streetcar costs $500, organizers take a small cut and the rest of the money goes to the artists).
No refunds. 

A Word on the Price: 
$30 is steep for a show. Last year we charged $20 and would have preferred to keep it at that price but the fees for the streetcar rental went up substantially. In order to pay the musicians what we want to, we needed to increase the fees.
Please consider: these concerts are truly one-of-a-kind in a beautiful intimate venue. To have high quality live music shows on a 100-year old streetcar, on a 100-year old bridge over a majestic river, at sunset is - as far as we know - done nowhere else in the world. The $30 per ticket covers the price of the ride and decent pay for the musicians. We think it's entirely worth it. We hope you will too.

description:
Join us at noon on September 19 to hear our special guest, Governor Sam Brownback, who will discuss judicial selection in the State of Kansas.  With the recent confirmation of Caleb Stegall to the Kansas Court of Appeals, and the recent nomination of a Kansas Supreme Court Justice to the 10th Circuit Court of Appeals, Kansas is engaged in a wide-ranging debate concerning the most open and transparent way to select its judges.   

Our menu includes a house salad, Roman Chicken (seared French cut breast of chicken topped with roasted tomatoes, sweet peppers, prosciutto, capers, Parmesan cheese and herb), creamy mashed potatoes, and your choice of pineapple upside-down cake or chocolate layer cake.  All accompanied by your choice of coffee, iced tea, or water. If you need any special menu accommodations, please contact us below.

Sam Brownback was sworn in as governor of Kansas on January 9, 2011.

Brownback served as Secretary of the Kansas Board of Agriculture from 1986 - 1993. During that time he also served as a White House Fellow in President George H. W. Bush’s administration. In 1994, Kansans elected Brownback to the U.S. House of Representatives and, two years later, to the U.S. Senate seat once held by former Senator Bob Dole. In the Senate, Brownback was an effective advocate for Kansas interests while serving on the Appropriations Committee, the Agriculture Appropriations Subcommittee and the Homeland Security Subcommittee. He was a founding member of the Senate Fiscal Watch Team. Honoring his pledge to only serve two elected terms in the U.S. Senate, he did not seek reelection in 2010.

As governor, Brownback is focused on growing the state’s economy and increasing private sector jobs through improved regulations, controlled spending and lower tax rates. He has five measurable goals for his administration: Increase in net personal income; increase in private sector employment; increase in the percentage of 4th graders reading at grade level; increase in the percentage of high school graduates who are college or career ready; and decrease in the percentage of Kansas’ children who live in poverty.

Brownback and his wife, Mary, have five children, two of them are adopted. He graduated from Kansas State University in 1978 and the University of Kansas Law School in 1982.

We have a number of these local producers coming to speak to us about the challenges and opportunities they have been facing. NOLAFC works closely with designers, connecting them with resources needed to grow their businesses.

Since the inaugural season of NOLAF in March 2011, we have produced over 80 fashion events in the greater New Orleans region with designers like: Sophomore NYC, by Smith, Cavortress, Jolie & Elizabeth, Amanda deLeon, Andrea Loest, Annie Griffin, blackout. by Ashley Ming, Matthew Arthur, Libellule, Loretta Jane, dope., Leah Milana, Varela + Brooks, Brennan Manuel, Rogersliu, Izavel, Ottilie Brodmann, Niré, Cocodri and Coco Bourgeouisie.

Workshops were led by industry experts from brands including Vera Wang, L'Oréal Professionnel, Anthropologie, J. Crew, Tommy Hilfiger, and Goorin Bros.

During each week long season of NOLAFW - Fall/Winter held in March and Spring/Summer held in October: 30+ events are held at various locations in and around the Greater New Orleans area. Along side designer-focused runway shows and presentations, events include a regional Retail Shopping Day as well as a Fashion Market. Open to buyers and the public, NOLAFW’s Fashion Market features emerging independent Southern based and born designer collections, as well as local artisan brands.

NOLAFC’s events have reached more than 80 million people with press placements in over 80 outlets spanning 3 continents and has reached over 1.4 million users through social media and has consistently been a trending topic in the region.

description:
This film is about the relationships of three couples- straight and gay - where love is a dance they do in and out of each other's arms

I am raising funds to create a film whose inspiration came to me in the middle of the night.  I woke up with two women lovers dancing in my head, and soon it turned into two men, and then a man and a woman; all dancing in twos, exploring each other, the space between them, their attraction and repulsion, and ultimately, their love.  What started as a work of choreography became a film one evening as I sat in a cafe in the old streets of Paris and saw the dancers partnering each other on that very street in my mind.  I realized that this film needed to me made; needed to be shared with the world; needed to end the invisible absence of homosexual love in the world of classical contemporary dance and in the world.  In this time of a return to equality and civil rights, I cannot think of a more appropriate film to be made. A story told completely by dance, to Cello Sonata in A minor by Norwegian composer Grieg, choreographed and directed by Lauren Brim, and filmed in Paris, the city of love.

I hope you will support our vision!  I am bringing together six dancers from Europe and the United States to tell the story of these three couples.  We will rehearse for a month, and film over 3 days the first week in October.

Risks and challenges

 

The first obstacle is always at the level of the mind, but this I overcome each day when I wake up and commit to the vision I've been given. The second obstacle is to get all of the artists in the same place at the same time, to which I work each week to overcome through communication and planning. The third obstacle is funding for the cameramen, equipment, flights, hotels, food, rehearsal space and editing that is required to make the film, and to overcome this, I need your help. I have an amazing team of dancers, experienced film people, and lovers of people and art who will see this through to completion. I have choreographed and completed countless projects, and see no reason why I would not also complete this. Upon completion, I will share it with the world through whatever means I discover, and make the world a little better through art.

Budget: 
2 Cameras: $1500-2000/day for 3 days 
Camera operator: $700/day for 3 days 
Camera Assistant: $500/day for 3 days 
Lighting and Grip: $5,000 (I will try to keep the lighting and grip crew small with a Gaffer, Key Grip and Swing (grip & electric). 
Rehearsal/studio space: 11 euro an hour for 40 hours 
Hard drives: 2 at ($150-200/each) 
Editing: still shopping for offers 
Cameraman: $2,500/day for 3 days 
Flights for 4 people to Paris: $6000 
Hotels for 4 people in Paris for 1 week: $2800

You can also support us through airline miles, contacts in the film world in Paris, apartments in the city where I can house cast and crew, contacts to film festivals, etc. Please email me at laurenbrim@gmail.com. Thank you!

description:
Dan Budnik's historic photographs covering the seminal marches of the Civil Rights movement, 1958-1965, brought to life in a new book.

The photographs by US photojournalist Dan Budnik, documenting three marches of the Civil Rights Movement, 1958-1965, present a unique body of work representing Dr. King’s legacy of non-violence as a way of affecting political and social change. Budnik’s Civil Rights work has rarely been seen. Now, on the 50th anniversary of Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.’s “I Have A Dream” speech, Trolley Books is proud to announce the publication ofMarching To The Freedom Dream, in Spring 2014. We need your support, through pledges and pre-orders for the book to become a reality. 

Recently Dan Budnik’s photographs from the 28th August 1963, March on Washington were rediscovered by the editors of TIME Magazine. On this day, Dr. King delivered his “I Have a Dream” speech to a record crowd of 250,000 people who had assembled peacefully at the Lincoln Memorial from all cardinal points. TIME's commemorative website and “I Have a Dream” anniversary issue prominently feature Budnik’s images. Phil Bicker, senior photo editor at TIME and the creative lead on the TIME project was delighted to add: 

"Dan Budnik is amongst American photography's best kept secrets. His exceptional images from the Civil Rights era have been rarely seen since they were taken half a century ago. Recently his remarkable photographs from the March on Washington were extensively featured in TIME's special commemorative website and special issue, along with his portrait of Martin Luther King Jr. adorning one of TIME's most memorable covers.” 

Cover of special commemorative issue of TIME magazine, profile portrait of King moments after his greatest speech 'I Have A Dream' by Dan Budnik
name: Dan Budnik - Marching To The Freedom Dream

description:
SPE Mid-Continent Luncheon Meeting — Friday, September 27, 2013
11:20 a.m.-1:00 p.m.
Summit Club, 30th Floor, Banquet Room 
Speaker: J.A. (John) Turley
Topic: "An Engineering Look at the Cause of BP's 2010 Blowout & Oil Spill"

 

Description
BP's Macondo blowout and oil spill on 20 April 2010 killed eleven men, sank the Deepwater Horizon, devastated the Gulf, and shocked the world. John Turley made an early observation about the disaster: Only if we understand and care about the cause of BP's Macondo blowout, will we know why it should not have happened and why it should never happen again.

Even as hearings were launched, Turley ignored finger-pointing and hearsay evidence and studied well data and federal/academic/corporate investigative reports. He published a book in September 2012 about the human, operating, and engineering causes of the catastrophe.

John's presentation is about his documented findings, from the perspective of a petroleum engineer to academic, civil, operating, and technical audiences throughout the oil-and-gas industry. In the presentation, which is NOT about his book, he focuses on documented drilling data that define links in a chain of events that led to and caused the blowout: the formation of a fluid leak . . . testing for leaks . . . exacerbating the leak . . . failing to see the leak . . . declaring the well secure . . . causing the well to flow . . . allowing the well to flow until too late. Turley's presentation starts at the seafloor, with the foundation of the well. Using engineering drawings, he and his audience rapidly drill the 3-1/2-mile-deep well, make a major discovery, then work through the remainder of the temporary-abandonment well program, experiencing, observing, making engineering decisions . . . both as intended, and as executed. The tragic result was one of the most lethal, manmade, environmental catastrophes in U.S. history. The audience leaves with engineering and operating knowledge about the cause, and a goal to never allow a repeat of the same.

 

Speaker
 J.A. (John) Turley

John Turley's early resume includes Phillips Petroleum, Fluor Ocean Services, Tenneco Oil Company, and Marietta College (professor, petroleum engineering). During the next twenty-five years with Marathon Oil Company, he held responsibilities as Gulf Coast drilling manager, U.K. operations manager, manager of worldwide drilling, and VP of engineering & technology. His academics include petroleum engineering (Colorado School of Mines), ocean engineering (University of Miami), and executive education at Harvard Business School.

After early retirement from Marathon, John focused on writing mystery novels, though that second career changed the day after BP's April 2010 blowout aboard the Deepwater Horizon in the Gulf of Mexico. Twenty-nine months later, he published THE SIMPLE TRUTH: BP's Macondo Blowout. The book is data-driven and research-based (though it's presented as a novel for ease of reading). A detailed nonfiction Epilogue defines the engineering, operating, and human causes of the disaster. With John's background, he assessed and wrote about the blowout from multiple perspectives: academic, on-the-rig, petroleum engineering, drilling management, and executive. Mr. Turley is a professional speaker on the topic to civic and academic groups, to professional societies, to commercial conferences, and to oil-and-gas companies. More information can be found in his Website: JohnTurleyWriter.com.

Meer halen uit wat je doet? Zoek je naar een manier hoe je dit het beste kunt aanpakken?

Erachter komen wat de samenhang is van wat je doet is de start naar jouw succes. Of je nu freelancer, startende ondernemer of iemand bent die wil weten hoe je eigen droom realiteit kan maken, dan is deze training precies wat je zoekt.

Oorspronkelijk Netwerken biedt inzichten in hoe je kunt netwerken vanuit je kracht en wat er al is.

 

Waarom deelnemen?

Ik weet uit eigen ervaring hoe moeilijk het is om wat je doet met elkaar in samenhang te brengen. Veel weten we eigenlijk al, hoe het allemaal bij elkaar komt is vaak de moeilijkste stap.

Ik neem je daarom op een leuke, praktische en visuele wijze mee om hoe je anders naar je netwerkvaardigheden kan kijken. De training zal zeer interactief zijn zodat je direct van anderen kan leren en feedback te krijgen.

Je ga je laten zien hoe je met een andere blik naar jouw bestaande situatie kan kijken. Je zult nieuwe mogelijkheden ontdekken hoe je effectiever je netwerk kan inzetten.

Ik beloof je dat je na afloop het geleerde direct kan toepassen en het verschil zal ervaren.


Wie ben ik?

Na jaren als headhunter gewerkt te hebben, heb ik het voorrecht gehad met veel mensen in contact te komen. Ik heb gemerkt dat iedereen dromen heeft en velen moeite hebben om de eerste stap te zetten. Ik heb besloten mijn achtergrond te gebruiken om die eerste stap praktisch inzichtelijk te maken en daarmee de stap eenvoudiger te maken.

Via Oorspronkelijk Zijn deel ik mijn ervaring om jouw op weg te helpen om je doelen te helpen realiseren.

description:
Portrait Sculpture Course / Sept 20 - Nov 8
Classical and Expressive Modeling in Clay 

Have you ever wondered, "How did the artist do that?” In this class, students will learn how to create a likeness in clay using a portrait or live model as the subject. Students will complete one portrait focusing on the underlying anatomical structures common in all portraiture, the skull and the plane structures, muscle structure, detailing the eyes, nose, mouth and ears will also be covered.

Starting with the skull as a base structure, students will gradually build the portrait learning about measurements, proportions and the basic planes.Students will be shown how to simplify a complex subject, the human face, and make it life like. The instructors in-depth knowledge is broken down, step by step, in easy to understand exercises.

Students will photograph their work in process so they can compare the different stages, approaches and the development of their work. They will explore classical sculpting techniques and expressive modelling methods of creating a variety of moods. Throughout the course there will be instructor demonstrations, including a demonstration of how to capture facial expressions. There will be additional demonstrations and discussions on finishing techniques for your sculpture.

This course is designed for both beginners and intermediate sculptors and will deepen the participants' understanding of the portrait.                 

Visit www.drawing.ie for more information

The SteamPlant is a stylish, urban event venue in downtown Salida, Colo. The renovated 1887 steam power plant retains its architectural beauty while exuding a chic atmosphere. For dining and receptions, the venue offers a spacious ballroom with century-old, exposed brick walls, natural hardwood floors and 30-foot ceilings. It seats up to 180 guests, has full banquet and concert facilities and overlooks a picturesque outdoor cobblestone plaza and the Arkansas River. On warm evenings, many events extend onto the plaza for drinks, dining and dancing under a canopy of stars. The grounds additionally include a 200-seat theater, several art galleries and boutique convention space with fully equipped conference rooms. Each is linked by a cobblestone walkway that stretches to the banks of the river and is surrounded by stunning views of the Rocky Mountains

Call 719.530.0933 to book your next conference, concert, wedding, theater, cinema or other happening. You can also visit our website or email us at info at salidasteamplant.com.

description:
Viral video. Digital storytelling. Social media. Buzz building…

The era of traditional marketing is over.

The power of the Internet has hobbled interruptive advertising and hard sales. Interactive marketing has emerged to fill in the gap. Some experts view a highly structured approach to interactive marketing as the way to success. Others emphasize random forces and unexpected insights.

We’ve brought together a panel of viral video pioneers, master storytellers, and content marketing gurus to help you make sense of it all.

Together we’ll be exploring the two main schools of thought in interactive marketing so you can walk away with the tools you need to grow your business online.

Topics include:

  • Building your Internet marketing campaign
  • How to use storytelling to succeed
  • Creating characters to attract attention online
  • Directing and writing viral videos
  • The role of social media
  • Using analytics to measure and improve a campaign’s effectiveness
  • Interactive marketing for tech companies vs. professional services firms

Wine and food will be served.


SPEAKER BIOS

James Percelay: Cofounder of the viral video marketing agency, Thinkmodo. With producer partner, Michael Krivicka, his clients include major Hollywood film studios, as well as numerous consumer brands. Thinkmodo’s attention-getting videos have garnered multiple industry awards. The agency was selected by Advertising Age as one of the top fifty creative agencies of 2013 in its “Creativity 50” edition.

James is a regular on the “Today Show”, and has been profiled in hundreds of interviews including The New York Times, CNN, BBC, The Insider, and NPR. He is a former producer of the commercial parodies on “Saturday Night Live,” and a TV development executive at Hearst Entertainment. He created a media sensation from his bi-racial production company, 2 Bros. & A White Guy, through which he co-authored the five-part best-selling African American insult humor book series, “SNAPS”. Featured in People, New York Times, and on hundreds of TV and radio shows, James & company leveraged the book into an HBO series, MTV series, an album for Atlantic Records, and a JC Penny clothing line. James created and produced two seasons of the webisode “High Drama” for Warner Bros. He is a member of the WGA and PGA New Media Counsel. James is a regular speaker on the subject of marketing innovation.

Blair Singer: New York-based television writer and playwright who ran lonelygirl15, the notorious faux-reality YouTube series. Lonelygirl15 was also notable for having been the first Internet series to introduce product integration. Blair has also written for shows including “Weeds,” “Monk,” “Beauty and the Beast,” and “The Book of Daniel.” He is currently involved in a variety of interactive projects that combine traditional entertainment with features of advertising and marketing. Blair graduated with a degree in English from UCLA, and went on to study at Julliard’s Drama Division.

Stephanie Beadell: Leads the Digital PR Team at SEER Interactive, one of Philadephia’s most prominent online search marketing agencies. Launched the first ever initiative to create and market a Halloween costume based on a character from a web series (The Guild), resulting in sales and traffic records and profiles in Wired, The Mary Sue, and GigaOM. Her analysis on the Harlem Shake social media phenomenon was featured on The Today Show, Social Media Examiner, and NME. Her clients have also been featured in Forbes, Fox News, Venture Beat, and TechCrunch, to name just a few.

MODERATOR

Michael Schein is the founder and Principal of Michael Schein Communications, a content marketing consulting firm and creative agency that implements systems and process that turn businesses into recognized authorities in their fields for the purpose of driving new business online. He has created (or facilitated the production of) content for companies including eBay, Linkedin, Avectra, TESLA, Inc., SEER Interactive, Interneer, Arise Virtual Solutions, and Citrix. He graduated from the University of Pennsylvania with Honors and got his start at Spin the Bottle, Inc., the production company behind VH1 hit show Pop Up Video. He is also the author of Teenage Roadhogs, published by MacMillan Books.
name: Structure or Serendipity: What is the Future Of Interactive Marketing?

description:
Virtual Collaboration: Effective Communications for Working Together from a Distance

In an increasingly virtual world, working collaboratively requires skills in developing effective relationships in an on-line format. Maintaining authentic communications in that virtual space however, can be a challenge.

 

This session will explore the key differences between online and face-to-face communications and provide how-to’s for increasing your virtual collaboration and communication skills.

 

Topics covered will include:

 

 

 

  • Strategies to create relationship-focused virtual communications
  • Methods for overcoming essential differences between virtual and in-person meetings
  • Effective practices in facilitating virtual project teams and developing online communities
  • New effective habits for the ‘digital age’

 

This session will be informative and interactive; and will include discussions, activities and takeaways.

 

About the Facilitator:

 

Ben Ziegler is a mediator, collaboration consultant and virtual facilitator. Ben serves as a mediator and mentor in the BC Court Mediation Program, consults to organizations in areas of information technology/management and collaborative process design and works as a virtual team facilitator on innovation challenges with IdeaConnection.com. He has authored e-books on collaboration and creative dispute resolution, 250 blog posts on collaboration-related topics at CollaborativeJourneys.com and is an avid user of social media, including Twitter (@benziegler) and LinkedIn.

 

About the Venue & Other Details:

 

This session will be held at Volunteer Victoria at 620 View St., third floor, suite 306. Coffee, tea and light refreshments will be served. Please bring a bag lunch.

description:
Brought to you by the PGSA in association with AURAC (the rock climbing club) and Engineering PGSA, we have a night of fun, learning a new sport rock climbing! We'd like to extend a bit of a challenge to you, think outside the box and see what sports you can learn to do. The ticket price includes transportation, equipment hire, entry to Extreme Edge Panmure, and free food and drink all night long! The ticket prices alone are a 50% savings on the usual entry costs! Last year when we held this event, tickets sold out fast so please act quickly to lock in your spot!


Rock climbing is one of NZ's fastest growing pastimes. With all of the rough terrain in this country, it allows for lots of open spaces for climbing. It appeals to people from all walks of life. Whether you're after some time out from the city with family and friends or wanting to push the boundaries of insanity, this sport offers both and everything in between. And the best part is this... you can kill two birds with one stone, exercise and have fun!


It's hard to appreciate just how big the Extreme Edge in Panmure is unless you've been here but trust us, it's big. An old aircraft hangar, converted into New Zealand's largest indoor climbing wall, we are confident that the scale will blow you away...


Extreme Edge Panmure is unmatched as far as catering for new climbers, but don't be fooled - once you get your confidence up, the sky is the limit! They have 60 top-ropes, accessing a huge range of climbing walls (over 200 climbing options), with another massive overhanging wall reserved for lead climbing. There's also a ClimbZone section with automatic belays for the true beginners to learn basic skills. Mean nothing to you? Well, that's fair enough, like we said, it's hard to appreciate the scale unless you're here. Lets put it a different way - what we have is an aircraft hanger that's the size of a quarter acre section and the height of a four storey building at its highest point. There are more than 200 routes to climb at any one time from absolute beginner to as hard as you'll find in any climbing wall on the planet.

You don't need any special gear either, just turn up in sensible clothes that give you decent freedom of movement (jeans or skirts are not really recommended) and trainers. You can hire harnesses and climbing shoes as part of the ticket price.

For further information please check: http://www.extremeedge.co.nz/panmure

 

All tickets are Non-Refundable. Make sure you would be able to make it to the event when you purchase the tickets.

Limited guest tickets are available at same time.

Your ticket includes

       - Round trip bus ride from city campus (Pickup at Alfred Street in front of the library) to Extreme Edge Panmure. We leave from campus on the bus at 5:30 PM and return to campus from Extreme Edge Panmure at 10:00 PM.

       - Entry to Extreme Edge Panmure for the night, including unlimited climbing ($21 value)

 

       - Free food and drink to keep you well fed and hydrated for the climb. Please e-mail us if you have specific dietary requirements.

 

       - All safety equipment is included in ticket fee (harness, proper climbing shoes, proper safety training)

       - AURAC in conjunction with Extreme Edge Panmure will show any newcomers how to properly climb, with correct techniques and maximum safety. There are climbing conditions available for all fitness levels, from beginner to expert. So everyone is invited!

Note: No pay at door options available for this event due to short sale period.
name: Rock Climbing at Extreme Edge Panmure

description:
FAQs

 

What happens in the Modification Workshop?

With the assistance of a Modifcation Specialist, We will be prequalifying homeowners for a loan modification, preparing documents, and faxing modification packages to your lender.

 

Why should I attend the workshop?

When attending the workshop, the modification specialist will prequalify you for the type of modification you qualify for. You will also be provided follow up questions and techniques to track the progress of your modification, as well as to overcome obstacles if needed.

All participants will also become a automatic member in our modification database to keep notes and records of all calls to your lender, and you will access to resources be able to upload documents in the database in one area for additional faxing.

All neccesay documents for your modification package will be provided and completed in the workshop.

 

What do I need to bring to the Modification Workshop?

 DOCUMENTS NEEDED:

Proof Of Income (Last 2 Paystubs -  Lease Agreements - SSI Award Letter- etc.)

2012 Tax Returns (Signed & Dated)

Last 2 Months Bank Statements (All Pages)

OPTIONAL DOCUMENTS:

Mortgage Statement (Optional)

Property Tax Bill (Optional)

Homeowners Insurance Declaration Page (Optional)

Original Loan Documents (Optional)

 

Note: All other documents for the loan modification will be provided and completed in the workshop.

RMA - 4606T - Financial Form - Hardship Letter - Profit & Loss Statements - Etc.

 

What if I have a Sale/Auction Date Pending?

In many cases we may be able to stop or postpone pending sale/auction dates during the modification process.

 

Is my registration/ticket transferrable?

Yes. The ticket is transferrable if the office is notified prior to attending the Modification Workshop.

 

Do I have to bring my printed ticket to the event?

Yes. The modification workshops are "Registered Participants Only".

 

Do you accept walk-ins?

Yes. However there will be additional $250 charge for walk-ins if there is available space after the all the registered participants.

 

What is the refund policy?

In the event that you cant attend your scheduled modification workshop, You may attend another modification workshop or transfer your ticket to another person.

Note: Be sure to notify the office of the transferred ticket 24 hrs prior to the schedule workshop date.

 

May I bring another person to the worshop?

Yes. For an additonal $150 if the person in on the mortgage. A new ticket has to be purchased at full charge for all other participants.
name: Copy of Loan Modification Workshops (Homeowners)

description:
Exposition au sein de l’Art Lounge du Sofitel Marrakech Lounge & Spa des œuvres de l’artiste « Morgane Lloret ». Matières, Patines, Couleurs d’automne, Croquis… . La terre et le ciel se mélangent…, le vertige des images en jouant sur les perspectives, tantôt avec douceur tantôt avec force. Automne Hiver, une nouvelle facette de son esprit qu'elle nous offre. Laissez-vous "renverser" par sa vision du monde... 

 

Vernissage le lundi 16 septembre 2013 à 18h30

 

Biographie de l'artiste:

Née en France à Ambilly, dés son enfance elle est plongée par sa mère dans l’univers du «beau», de l’esthétique, de la création d’espaces et de leurs fonctions, autrement dit: l’architecture d’intérieur et la décoration.

Elle grandit ainsi au milieu des tissus de luxe, des chantiers de maisons grandioses et des croquis.

Après des études à la Haute Ecole d’Arts et de Design (HEAD) de Genève, elle rejoint sa mère dans sa nouvelle entreprise d’architecture et d’évènementiel: made in Diva, forte du savoir fraîchement appris et de son expérience déjà acquise au fil des années avec sa maman.

Jeune architecte, elle représente la nouvelle génération par sa créativité, sa justesse et son originalité atypique.

Devant faire preuve d’imagination et de talent pour donner vie aux rêves des gens. Elle commence à utiliser ses connaissances en informatique pour créer des images représentant les projets accomplis ou pour immerger le client dans l’ambiance de son futur espace.

Sa technique? Superposition, mélange, mariage et fusion d’images lui permettent de concrétiser tout ceci. Petit à petit les images sont devenues de plus en plus complexes et précieuses, jusqu’à atteindre une échelle, où l’image se suffit d’elle même et se sépare de son essence première pour acquérir la sienne, sa propre identité, une œuvre d’art...
name: Morgane Lloret: collection automne/hiver

description:
APPEL A CANDIDATURE

 

Le 1 octobre 2012 débute la 1éme édition des « Trophées de l’Engagement Solidaire », l’occasion pour toutes les associations qui s’engagent et agissent au quotidien au sein de la société marocaine de se faire connaître et d’être soutenues.

 

Cette opération a pour vocation de donner un véritable coup de pouce et de projecteur aux associations et aux actions remarquables qu’elles développent dans quatre domaines :


• HUMANITAIRE & CARITATIF
• ENVIRONNEMENT & DEVELOPPEMENT
• CULTURE & EDUCATION
• ENFANCE & JEUNESSE

 

Pour sa première édition, 40 d’initiatives seront mises en lumière et 13 associations lauréates se partageront une dotation importante et de nombreux prix.

Il y aura 3 lauréats par catégorie et un prix spécial Web projecteur.

 

Ainsi, parce que chacun peut être acteur de cette démarche solidaire, le cabinet Conseil Affaire Publique invite les responsables associatifs, les bénévoles, le grand public à amplifier ce mouvement de soutien aux associations et jusqu’au 15 décembre 2012 à inscrire, recommander ou soutenir son association sur le site : trophee.cap.ma

 

Cette opération a été créée afin d’encourager les acteurs de terrain et contribuer à mettre en avant leur formidable créativité et leur mobilisation pour accompagner le développement de l’engagement solidaire plus particulièrement.

 

Un dispositif participatif de solidarité ouvert à tous et accessible par Internet sera mis à disposition. Le comité organisateur appelle donc à une mobilisation du plus grand nombre afin que soient identifiées et donc contactées les associations concernées par cette opération.

description:
Default Judgment Workshop:

Have you served your spouse with your Dissolution, Legal Separation, or Nullity Petition filed in Sacramento Superior Court? Have you completed your financial disclosures? Are you wondering what you have left to do to conclude your case? Or, do you want to request a default hearing to ask for specific orders to be included in your Judgment?

The Default Judgment workshop is available for self-represented Petitioners with cases in Sacramento Superior Court who meet the following criteria:

• The other party must have been served at least 31 days ago (by a third party over the age of 18), or 41 days ago if served by certified mail out-of-state.
• Proof of Service of Summons must be on file with the court (or be ready to file).
• The other party must not have filed a Response with the court.
• You have completed the Preliminary and Final Financial Disclosure process.
• The other party cannot be in active military service.
• You must not be requesting anything other than you requested in the Petition.

In this two-hour workshop, you will prepare the paperwork necessary to file a request for default judgment, in order to finalize your case without having to go to court. You will complete a Request to Enter Default, a Property Declaration, a Declaration for Default or Uncontested Dissolution/Legal Separation, a Judgment, and a Notice of Entry of Judgment.

You will leave with full written instructions, including information about the processing timeframe, and how to properly submit your paperwork to the court.

Request to Enter Default only

The Request to Enter Default, one of the documents covered in the Default Judgment workshop, can also be used by the Petitioner to request a court hearing to ask for specific orders to be included in their Judgment. Participants who filed for a Nullity of Marriage/Domestic Partnership or do not have existing Child Custody, Visitation and/or Child Support Orders may consider participating in the workshop to complete the Request to Enter Default only (approximately the first half hour of the workshop). Upon submission to the court, they may request that the clerk schedule a “Default Hearing” so the litigant may appear in court and the Judge may make rulings in the case.

To participate in the Default Judgment workshop:

YOU MUST BRING

1. ALL OF YOUR SACRAMENTO SUPERIOR COURT DOCUMENTS WITH YOU, including the Petition, Proof of Service of Summons, financial disclosures, any existing court orders, including domestic violence restraining orders (if applicable) and a notarized Marital Settlement Agreement (if applicable).

 2.  Photo Identification

CANCELLATION POLICY:  Refunds given if cancellation is received no later than 24 hours prior to the start time of the workshop.
name: Default Judgment Workshop

description:
Guardianship Petition Workshop

Are you a non-parent seeking to assume the care, custody and control over a minor child? Are you interested in filing a guardianship so you have legal authority as their caregiver?

 

Filing a probate guardianship is the method for a non-parent (grandparent, aunt/uncle, other relative or interested party) to care for a minor child when the child’s parents are unable to do so. A probate guardianship is properly filed in the county where the child(ren) reside, or in the county where there is an existing child custody case.  This workshop is open to self-represented petitioners who will be filing a case in Sacramento County.

 

In Part I of this two-part workshop, participants will learn about the process of filing for guardianship and how to prepare for the home visit and court hearing in a one-hour class. Then, in the two-hour Part II class, participants will complete the required court forms for submission to the probate department to initiate their case.

Part I is a prerequisite for the Part II Class.  Each class must be scheduled separately.

Participants will leave the workshop series with their completed forms and full instructions on how to proceed.

FAQs

 

What happens in the Modification Workshop?

With the assistance of a Modifcation Specialist, you will be prequalified for a loan modification. All documents will be prepared, completed and faxed to your lender during the workshop.

 

Why should I attend the workshop?

When attending the workshop, the modification specialist will prequalify you for the type of modification you qualify for. You will also be provided follow up questions and techniques to track the progress of your modification, as well as methods of how to overcome obstacles if needed.

All participants will also become a member in our resource database to keep notes and records of all calls to your lender, and you will be able to upload documents in the database in one area for additional faxing.

 

What if I have a Sale/Auction Date Pending?

There are many options to Stop a Sale Date. In many cases we may be able to stop or postpone pending sale/auction dates during the modification process. In most workshops there will staff if you need further assistance.

What if I file Bankruptcy?

In many cases even though a homeowner has filed bankrupcy, they will still need a modification to lower their monthly payments & capitalize back payments.

Note: You will learn how bankruptcy works with modifications inside the workshop.

 

What do I need to bring to the Modification Workshop?

 DOCUMENTS NEEDED:

Proof Of Income (Last 2 Paystubs -  Lease Agreements - SSI Award Letter- etc.)

2012 Tax Returns (Signed & Dated)

Last 2 Months Bank Statements (All Pages)

OPTIONAL DOCUMENTS:

Mortgage Statement (Optional)

Property Tax Bill (Optional)

Homeowners Insurance Declaration Page (Optional)

Original Loan Documents (Optional)

 

Note: All other documents for the loan modification will be provided and completed in the workshop.

RMA - 4606T - Financial Form - Hardship Letter - Profit & Loss Statements - Etc.

 

Do I have to bring my printed ticket to the event?

Yes. The modification workshops are "Registered Participants Only".

 

Is my registration/ticket transferrable?

Yes. The ticket is transferrable if the office is notified prior to attending the Modification Workshop.

 

May I bring another person to the workshop?

Yes. The ticket will be discounted to $150 ONLY to co-borrower on the mortgage. A new ticket must be purchased at full price for all other participants to attend the workshop.

Note: Please bring mortgage statement with co-borrower name.

Do you accept walk-ins?

Yes.  Walk-ins will ONLY be accepted if there is available space after the registered participants. The price will be $500.

 

What is the refund policy?

In the event that you cant attend your scheduled modification workshop, You may attend the next scheduled modification workshop or you may transfer your ticket to another person.

Note: Be sure to notify the office of the transferred ticket 24 hrs prior to the scheduled workshop date.

description:
Creative Talk @ FORMOSA SHOW 2013 :: London Design Festival

Position of Taiwan Design of Asia into Global  Market?


FORMOSA SHOW SHOW 2013 is honoured to invite three Taiwanese designers 周育潤Chou, Yu-Jui (Kevin) / 曾熙凱 Tseng, Shi-Kai /陳函谿 Chen, Han-Hsi  to give talks about their design concepts and to share their experiences of entering the global market, from the perspective of both Taiwan and the UK.



Date:Friday 20st September 2013

Time:19:00pm-21:00pm

Admission Free Donations Welcome

Booking:www.formosashow.co.uk/news/creative-talk-2013-position-of-taiwan-design-of-asia-into-global-market-


Venue:

Candid Arts Trust Gallery

3 Torrens Street , Islington, London EC1V 1NQ, UK



Speaker : 周育潤Chou, Yu-Jui (Kevin) (b. 1974) graduated in 2002 from the Cranbrook Academy of Art (USA). After six years as senior designer at Philips Design, he started his own studio, KEV Design, works vary from communications products to furniture. Chou has been recognized with various international design awards and is a lecturer at Shih Chien University since 2004. He collaborates often with IT industry and craft artisans, and specializes in finding intelligent solutions for the design.


KEV Design Studio creates a new lifestyle which fulfills our imagination and needs in the digital era.



Speaker : 曾熙凱 Tseng, Shi-Kai is more of a maker and design-artist, where he focus on culture, material and process, as he believe the culture generates the meaning and value of all the physical objects, and the objects are made of the combinations of materials and process. His works were shown by galleries and exhibition in London, Paris, Stockholm, Eindhoven, Milan and other cities. He was invited to participate In Recidence - Design Dialogue, which had been considered as one of the most important and influnced workshop in italy. ShiKai also had been featured in the one of the most influenced international design media - Frame magazine, with a personal interview in March/April 2013.











Speaker : 陳函谿 Chen, Han-Hsi  spent two years on the design brand Logical Art, which he co-founded in 2010. The process includes branding, design, production up to sales and promotion, which gives him a very solid background of production and strong sense of the market. The works are sold in major design shops around the globe, including Harrods, London Design Museum, Colette, Centre Pompidou, Printemps  etc.




Poetic Lab is a London-based joint studio founded by designer HanHsi Chen and Shikai Tseng after they met and graduated from Royal College of Art in London. The duo shares a central design philosophy of the studio - poetry of objects and materials, while they acquired very diversed experiences before they decided to work together, which enables them to shape an object from multiple perspectives.


The duo teamed up for an joint exhibition in SaloneSatellite 2013 called Beyond Object, where they showcasing a collection of objects composed by light and shadows. The results were better than expected, they claimed winner of the design report award, and third prize of Salone Satellite Award, both with the project Glass Ripple. The success soon led to an dedicated decision of a permanent joint  studio - Poetic Lab.
name: Position of Taiwan Design of Asia into Global  Market? @ Creative Talk
